When part of a living creature is placed in the bag, as happens when someone reaches inside it, there is a {@chance 50} chance that the creature is pulled inside the bag. A creature inside the bag can take an action to try to escape, doing so with a successful {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. Another creature can take an action to reach into the bag to pull a creature out, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check, provided the puller isn't pulled inside the bag first. Any creature that starts its turn inside the bag is devoured, its body destroyed.

Inanimate objects can be stored in the bag, which can hold a cubic foot of such material. However, once each day, the bag swallows any objects inside it and spits them out into another plane of existence. The DM determines the time and plane.
If the bag is pierced or torn, it is destroyed, and anything contained within it is transported to a random location on the Astral Plane.

item.name: Bag of Holding
entries: This bag has an interior space considerably larger than its outside dimensions—roughly 2 feet square and 4 feet deep on the inside. The bag can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The bag weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents. Retrieving an item from the bag requires a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action.

If the bag is overloaded, pierced, or torn, it is destroyed, and its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane. If the bag is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, but the bag must be put right before it can be used again. The bag holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Bag of Holding inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Heward's Handy Haversack|SRD52}, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way and can't be reopened.

item.name: Bag of Tricks, Gray
entries: This bag made from gray cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table below. See the {@book Monster Manual|SRD52} for the creature's stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Bag of Tricks, Rust
entries: This bag made from rust cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table below. See the {@book Monster Manual|SRD52} for the creature's stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Bag of Tricks, Tan
entries: This bag made from tan cloth appears empty. Reaching inside the bag, however, reveals the presence of a small, fuzzy object.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull the fuzzy object from the bag and throw it up to 20 feet. When the object lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling on the table below. See the {@book Monster Manual|SRD52} for the creature's stat block. The creature vanishes at the next dawn or when it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies, and it acts immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to command how the creature moves and what action it takes on its next turn, such as attacking an enemy. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature.
Once three fuzzy objects have been pulled from the bag, the bag can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ball Bearings
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can spill Ball Bearings from their pouch. They spread to cover a level, 10-foot-square area within 10 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Ball Bearings.

item.name: Barrel
entries: A Barrel holds up to 40 gallons of liquid or up to 4 cubic feet of dry goods.

item.name: Basic Poison
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can use a vial of Basic Poison to coat one weapon or up to three pieces of ammunition. A creature that takes Piercing or Slashing damage from the poisoned weapon or ammunition takes an extra {@damage 1d4} Poison damage. Once applied, the poison retains potency for 1 minute or until its damage is dealt, whichever comes first.

item.name: Basket
entries: A Basket holds up to 40 pounds within 2 cubic feet.

item.name: Bead of Force
entries: This small black sphere measures 3/4 of an inch in diameter and weighs an ounce. Typically, {@dice 1d4 + 4} Beads of Force are found together.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the bead up to 60 feet. The bead explodes in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} on impact and is destroyed. Each creature in the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere} must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 5d4} Force damage. A sphere of transparent force then encloses the area for 1 minute. Any creature that failed the save and is completely within the area is trapped inside this sphere. Creatures that succeeded on the save or are partially within the area are pushed away from the center of the sphere until they are no longer inside it. Only breathable air can pass through the sphere's wall. No attack or other effect can pass through.

An enclosed creature can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to push against the sphere's wall, moving the sphere up to half the creature's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. The sphere can be picked up, and its magic causes it to weigh only 1 pound, regardless of the weight of creatures inside.

item.name: Bead of Nourishment
entries: This flavorless, gelatinous bead dissolves on your tongue and provides as much nourishment as 1 day of Rations.

item.name: Bedroll
entries: A Bedroll sleeps one Small or Medium creature. While in a Bedroll, you automatically succeed on saving throws against {@hazard extreme cold|SRD52} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|SRD52}).

item.name: Bell
entries: When rung as a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.

item.name: Belt of Cloud Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 27. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Dwarvenkind
entries: While wearing this belt, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Dwarvish
entries: You know Dwarvish.

items.name: Friend of Dwarvenkind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|SRD52}) checks made to interact with dwarves and duergar.

items.name: Toughness
entries: Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20.
In addition, while attuned to the belt, you have a {@chance 50} chance each day at dawn of growing a full beard if you can grow one, or a thicker beard if you already have one.
If you aren't a dwarf or duergar, you gain the following additional benefits while wearing the belt:

items.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} with a range of 60 feet.

items.name: Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition.

item.name: Belt of Fire Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 25. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Frost Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 23. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Hill Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 21. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Stone Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 23. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Belt of Storm Giant Strength
entries: While wearing this belt, your Strength score changes to 29. The item has no effect on you if your Strength without the belt is equal to or greater than the belt's score.

item.name: Black Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Blanket
entries: While wrapped in a blanket, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against {@hazard extreme cold|SRD52} (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|SRD52}).

item.name: Block and Tackle
entries: A {@item Block and Tackle|SRD52} allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.

item.name: Blue Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Book
entries: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}, {@skill History|SRD52}, {@skill Nature|SRD52}, or {@skill Religion|SRD52}) checks you make about that topic.

item.name: Boots of Elvenkind
entries: While you wear these boots, your steps make no sound, regardless of the surface you are moving across. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|SRD52}) checks.

item.name: Boots of Levitation
entries: While you wear these boots, you can cast {@spell Levitate|SRD52} on yourself.

item.name: Boots of Speed
entries: While you wear these boots, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to click the boots' heels together. If you do, the boots double your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and any creature that makes an {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52} against you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the attack roll. If you click your heels together again, you end the effect.
When you've used the boots' property for a total of 10 minutes, the magic ceases to function for you until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

item.name: Boots of Striding and Springing
entries: While you wear these boots, your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} becomes 30 feet unless your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is higher, and your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} isn't reduced by you carrying weight in excess of your carrying capacity or wearing Heavy Armor.
Once on each of your turns, you can jump up to 30 feet by spending only 10 feet of movement.

item.name: Boots of the Winterlands
entries: These furred boots are snug and feel warm. While wearing them, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Cold Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Cold damage and can tolerate temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower without any additional protection.

entries.name: Winter Strider
entries: You ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} created by ice or snow.

item.name: Bowl of Commanding Water Elementals
entries: While this bowl is filled with water and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon a {@creature Water Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the bowl as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The bowl can't be used this way again until the next dawn.
The bowl is about 1 foot in diameter and half as deep. It holds about 3 gallons.

item.name: Bracers of Archery
entries: While wearing these bracers, you have proficiency with the {@item Longbow|SRD52} and {@item Shortbow|SRD52}, and you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with such weapons.

item.name: Bracers of Defense
entries: While wearing these bracers, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} if you are wearing no armor and using no {@item Shield|SRD52}.

item.name: Brass Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Brazier of Commanding Fire Elementals
entries: While you are within 5 feet of this brazier, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon a {@creature Fire Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the brazier as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The brazier can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Bronze Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Brooch of Shielding
entries: While wearing this brooch, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Force damage, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to damage from the {@spell Magic Missile|SRD52} spell.

item.name: Broom of Flying
entries: This wooden broom functions like a mundane broom until you stand astride it and take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to make it hover beneath you, at which time it can be ridden in the air. It has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 50 feet. It can carry up to 400 pounds, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} becomes 30 feet while carrying over 200 pounds. The broom stops hovering when you land or when you're no longer riding it.

As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can send the broom to travel alone to a destination within 1 mile of you if you name the location and are familiar with it. The broom comes back to you when you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and use a command word if the broom is still within 1 mile of you.

item.name: Bucket
entries: A Bucket holds up to half a cubic foot of contents.

item.name: Bullseye Lantern
entries: A Bullseye Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 60-foot Cone and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 60 feet.

item.name: Burglar's Pack
entries: A Burglar's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Ball Bearings|SRD52}, {@item Bell|SRD52}, 10 {@item Candle|SRD52|Candles}, {@item Crowbar|SRD52}, {@item Hooded Lantern|SRD52}, 7 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 5 days of {@item Rations|SRD52}, {@item Rope|SRD52}, {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}, and {@item Waterskin|SRD52}.

item.name: Burnt Othur Fumes
entries: A creature subjected to Burnt Othur Fumes must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or take 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage, and it must repeat the save at the start of each of its turns. On each successive failed save, the creature takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage. After three successful saves, the poison ends.

item.name: Caltrops
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can spread Caltrops from their bag to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. A creature that enters this area for the first time on a turn must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or take 1 Piercing damage and have its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. It takes 10 minutes to recover the Caltrops.

item.name: Candle
entries: For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 5-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 5 feet.

item.name: Candle of Invocation
entries: This candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from its total burn time.

While lit, the candle sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius. While you are within that light, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule D20 Test|SRD52|D20 Tests}. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots.

Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast {@spell Gate|SRD52} with it. Doing so destroys the candle. The portal created by the spell links to a particular Outer Plane chosen by the DM or determined by rolling on the following table.

item.name: Cape of the Mountebank
entries: This cape smells faintly of brimstone. While wearing it, you can use it to cast {@spell Dimension Door|SRD52} as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.
When you teleport with that spell, you leave behind a cloud of smoke. The space you left is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|SRD52} by that smoke until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Carpet of Flying, 3 ft. × 5 ft.
entries: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

A 3 ft. × 5 ft. carpet can carry up to 200 lb. at a fly speed of 80 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

item.name: Carpet of Flying, 4 ft. × 6 ft.
entries: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

A 4 ft. × 6 ft. carpet can carry up to 400 lb. at a fly speed of 60 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

item.name: Carpet of Flying, 5 ft. × 7 ft.
entries: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

A 5 ft. × 7 ft. carpet can carry up to 600 lb. at a fly speed of 40 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

item.name: Carpet of Flying, 6 ft. × 9 ft.
entries: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.

A 6 ft. × 9 ft. carpet can carry up to 800 lb. at a fly speed of 30 feet. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

item.name: Crawler Mucus (Contact)
entries: A creature subjected to Carrion Crawler Mucus must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. The creature also has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Censer of Controlling Air Elementals
entries: While gently swinging this censer, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon an {@creature Air Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the censer as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The censer can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Chain
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can wrap a Chain around an unwilling creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52}, or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition if you succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until it escapes. Escaping the Chain requires the creature to make a successful {@dc 18} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) check as an action. Bursting the Chain requires a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check as an action.

item.name: Chest
entries: A Chest holds up to 12 cubic feet of contents.

item.name: Chime of Opening
entries: This hollow metal tube measures about 1 foot long and weighs 1 pound. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can strike the chime to cast {@spell Knock|SRD52}. The spell's customary knocking sound is replaced by the clear, ringing tone of the chime, which is audible out to 300 feet. The chime can be used 10 times. After the tenth time, it cracks and becomes useless.

item.name: Circlet of Blasting
entries: While wearing this circlet, you can cast {@spell Scorching Ray|SRD52} with it ({@hit 5} to hit). The circlet can't cast this spell again until the next dawn.

item.name: Climber's Kit
entries: A Climber's Kit includes boot tips, gloves, pitons, and a harness. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can use the Climber's Kit to anchor yourself; when you do, you can't fall more than 25 feet from the anchor point, and you can't move more than 25 feet from there without undoing the anchor as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

item.name: Cloak of Arachnida
entries: This fine garment is made of black silk interwoven with faint, silvery threads. While wearing it, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Poison Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Poison damage.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries: You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} and can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free.

entries.name: Spider Walk
entries: You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}.

entries.name: Web
entries: You can cast {@spell Web|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}). The web created by the spell fills twice its normal area. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Cloak of Displacement
entries: While you wear this cloak, it magically projects an illusion that makes you appear to be standing in a place near your actual location, causing any creature to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you. If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn. This property is suppressed while your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is 0.

item.name: Cloak of Elvenkind
entries: While you wear this cloak, Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks made to perceive you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|SRD52}) checks.

item.name: Cloak of Invisibility
entries: This cloak has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the cloak, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull its hood over your head and expend 1 charge to give yourself the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you pull the hood down (no action required) or cease wearing the hood.

item.name: Cloak of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} and saving throws while you wear this cloak.

item.name: Cloak of the Bat
entries: While wearing this cloak, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|SRD52}) checks. In an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can grip the edges of the cloak and use it to gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 40 feet. If you ever fail to grip the cloak's edges while flying in this way, or if you are no longer in {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you lose this {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52}.

While wearing the cloak in an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can cast {@spell Polymorph|SRD52} on yourself, shape-shifting into a {@creature Bat|SRD52}. While in that form, you retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. The cloak can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Cloak of the Manta Ray
entries: While wearing this cloak, you can breathe underwater, and you have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52} of 60 feet.

item.name: Component Pouch
entries: A Component Pouch is watertight and filled with compartments that hold all the free Material components of your spells.

item.name: Copper Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Costume
entries: While wearing a Costume, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any ability check you make to impersonate the person or type of person it represents.

item.name: Crossbow Bolt Case
entries: A {@item Crossbow Bolt Case|SRD52} holds up to 20 Bolts.

item.name: Crowbar
entries: Using a Crowbar gives you {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

item.name: Crystal Ball
entries: The typical crystal ball, a very rare item, is about 6 inches in diameter. While touching it, you can cast the {@spell Scrying|SRD52} spell (save {@dc 17}) with it.

item.name: Crystal Ball of Mind Reading
entries: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast {@spell Scrying|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) with it. In addition, you can cast {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) targeting creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You don't need to concentrate on this {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the {@spell Scrying|SRD52} spell ends.

item.name: Crystal Ball of Telepathy
entries: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast {@spell Scrying|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) with it. In addition, you can communicate telepathically with creatures you can see within 30 feet of the spell's sensor. You can also cast {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) through the sensor on one of those creatures. You don't need to concentrate on this {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if {@spell Scrying|SRD52} ends. You can't cast {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} in this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Crystal Ball of True Seeing
entries: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast {@spell Scrying|SRD52} (save {@dc 17}) with it. In addition, you have {@sense Truesight|SRD52} with a range of 120 feet centered on the spell's sensor.

item.name: Cube of Force
entries: This cube is about an inch across. Each face has a distinct marking on it. You can press one of those faces, expend the number of charges required for it, and thereby cast the spell associated with it (save {@dc 17}), as shown in the Cube of Force Faces table.
The cube starts with 10 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Cubic Gate
entries: This cube is 3 inches across and radiates palpable magical energy. The six sides of the cube are each keyed to a different plane of existence, one of which is the Material Plane. The other sides are linked to planes determined by the DM.

The cube has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can expend 1 of the cube's charges to cast one of the following spells using the cube.

entries.name: Gate
entries: Pressing one side of the cube, you cast {@spell Gate|SRD52}, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

entries.name: Plane Shift
entries: Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast {@spell Plane Shift|SRD52}, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side.

item.name: Instant Fortress
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can place this 1-inch adamantine statuette on the ground and, using a command word, cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower. Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty. Each creature in the area where the tower appears is pushed to an unoccupied space outside but next to the tower. Objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried are also pushed clear of the tower.

The tower is 20 feet on a side and 30 feet high, with arrow slits on all sides and a battlement atop it. Its interior is divided into two floors, with a ladder, staircase, or ramp (your choice) connecting them. This ladder, staircase, or ramp ends at a trapdoor leading to the roof. When created, the tower has a single door at ground level on the side facing you. The door opens only at your command, which you can issue as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. It is immune to the {@spell Knock|SRD52} spell and similar magic.

{@action Magic|SRD52} prevents the tower from being tipped over. The roof, the door, and the walls each have AC 20; HP 100; {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage except that which is dealt by siege equipment; and {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to all other damage. Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower. Only a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell can repair the tower (this use of the spell counts as replicating a spell of level 8 or lower). Each casting of Wish causes the tower to regain all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

item.name: Dagger of Venom
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. The weapon can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Decanter of Endless Water
entries: This stoppered flask sloshes when shaken, as if it contains water. The decanter weighs 2 pounds.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to remove the stopper and issue one of three command words, whereupon an amount of fresh water or salt water (your choice) pours out of the flask. The water stops pouring out at the start of your next turn. Choose from the following command words:

items.name: Splash
entries: The decanter produces 1 gallon of water.

items.name: Fountain
entries: The decanter produces 5 gallons of water.

items.name: Geyser
entries: The decanter produces 30 gallons of water that gushes forth in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} 30 feet long and 1 foot wide. If you're holding the decanter, you can aim the geyser in one direction (no action required). One creature of your choice in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} must succeed on a {@dc 13} Strength saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage and have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. Instead of a creature, you can target one object in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} that isn't being worn or carried and that weighs no more than 200 pounds. The object is knocked over by the geyser.

item.name: Deck of Illusions
entries: This box contains a set of cards. A full deck has 34 cards: 32 depicting specific creatures and two with a mirrored surface. A deck found as treasure is usually missing {@dice 1d20 - 1} cards.

The magic of the deck functions only if its cards are drawn at random. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to draw a card at random from the deck and throw it to the ground at a point within 30 feet of yourself. An illusion of a creature, determined by rolling on the Deck of Illusions table, forms over the thrown card and remains until dispelled. The illusory creature created by the card looks and behaves like a real creature of its kind, except that it can do no harm. While you are within 120 feet of the illusory creature and can see it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to move it anywhere within 30 feet of its card.

Any physical interaction with the illusory creature reveals it to be false, because objects pass through it. A creature that takes a {@action Study|SRD52} action to visually inspect the illusory creature identifies it as an illusion with a successful {@dc 15} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|SRD52}) check. The illusion lasts until its card is moved or the illusion is dispelled (using a {@spell Dispel Magic|SRD52} spell or a similar effect). When the illusion ends, the image on its card disappears, and that card can't be used again.

item.name: Mysterious Deck
entries: Usually found in a box or pouch, this deck contains a number of cards made of ivory or vellum. Most (75 percent) of these decks have thirteen cards, but some have twenty-two. Use the appropriate column of the Deck of Many Things table when randomly determining cards drawn from the deck.

Before you draw a card, you must declare how many cards you intend to draw and then draw them randomly. Any cards drawn in excess of this number have no effect. Otherwise, as soon as you draw a card from the deck, its magic takes effect. You must draw each card no more than 1 hour after the previous draw. If you fail to draw the chosen number, the remaining number of cards fly from the deck on their own and take effect all at once.

Once a card is drawn, it disappears. Unless the card is the Fool or Jester, the card reappears in the deck, making it possible to draw the same card twice. (Once the Fool or Jester has left the deck, reroll on the table if that card comes up again.)
Each card's effect is described below.

entries.name: Balance
entries: You can increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 22, provided you also decrease another one of your ability scores by 2. You can't decrease an ability that has a score of 5 or lower. Alternatively, you can choose not to adjust your ability scores, in which case this card has no effect.

entries.name: Comet
entries: The next time you enter combat against one or more {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} creatures, you can select one of them as your foe when you roll {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52}. If you reduce your foe to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} during that combat, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|SRD52|Death Saving Throws} for 1 year. If someone else reduces your chosen foe to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or you don't choose a foe, this card has no effect.

entries.name: Donjon
entries: You disappear and become entombed in a state of suspended animation in an extradimensional sphere. Everything you're wearing and carrying disappears with you except for Artifacts, which stay behind in the space you occupied when you disappeared. You remain imprisoned until you are found and removed from the sphere. You can't be located by any Divination magic, but a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell can reveal the location of your prison. You draw no more cards.

entries.name: Euryale
entries: The card's medusa-like visage curses you. You take a -2 penalty to saving throws while cursed in this way. Only a god or the magic of the Fates card can end this curse.

entries.name: Fates
entries: Reality's fabric unravels and spins anew, allowing you to avoid or erase one event as if it never happened. You can use the card's magic as soon as you draw the card or at any other time before you die.

entries.name: Flames
entries: A powerful devil becomes your enemy. The devil seeks your ruin and torments you, savoring your suffering before attempting to slay you. This enmity lasts until either you or the devil dies.

entries.name: A Question of Enmity
entries: Two of the cards in the Deck of Many Things can earn a character the enmity of another being. With the Flames card, the enmity is overt. The character should experience the devil's malevolent efforts on multiple occasions. Seeking out the fiend shouldn't be a simple task, and the adventurer should clash with the devil's allies and followers a few times before being able to confront the devil.

In the case of the Rogue card, the enmity is secret and should come from someone thought to be a friend or an ally. As Dungeon Master, you should wait for a dramatically appropriate moment to reveal this enmity, leaving the adventurer guessing who is likely to become a betrayer.

entries.name: Fool
entries: You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule D20 Test|SRD52|D20 Tests} for the next 72 hours. Draw another card; this draw doesn't count as one of your declared draws.

entries.name: Gem
entries: Twenty-five pieces of jewelry worth 2,000 GP each or fifty gems worth 1,000 GP each appear at your feet.

entries.name: Jester
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule D20 Test|SRD52|D20 Tests} for the next 72 hours, or you can draw two additional cards beyond your declared draws.

entries.name: Key
entries: A Rare or rarer magic weapon with which you are proficient appears on your person. The DM chooses the weapon.

entries.name: Knight
entries: You gain the service of a {@creature Knight|SRD52}, who magically appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself. The knight has the same alignment as you and serves you loyally until death, believing the two of you have been drawn together by fate. Work with your DM to create a name and backstory for this NPC. The DM can use a different stat block to represent the knight, as desired.

entries.name: Moon
entries: You gain the ability to cast {@spell Wish|SRD52} {@dice 1d3} times.

entries.name: Puzzle
entries: Permanently reduce your Intelligence or Wisdom by {@dice 1d4 + 1} (to a minimum score of 1). You can draw one additional card beyond your declared draws.

entries.name: Rogue
entries: An NPC of the DM's choice becomes {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} toward you. You don't know the identity of this NPC until they or someone else reveals it. Nothing less than a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell or divine intervention can end the NPC's hostility toward you.

entries.name: Ruin
entries: All forms of wealth that you carry or own, other than magic items, are lost to you. Portable property vanishes. Businesses, buildings, and land you own are lost in a way that alters reality the least. If you have a Bastion (see the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|SRD52|7}), it is destroyed by some calamity beyond your control. Any documentation that proves you should own something lost to this card also disappears.

entries.name: Sage
entries: At any time you choose within one year of drawing this card, you can ask a question in meditation and mentally receive a truthful answer to that question.

entries.name: Skull
entries: An {@creature Avatar of Death|SRD52} appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The avatar targets only you with its attacks, appearing as a ghostly skeleton clad in a tattered black robe and carrying a spectral scythe. The avatar disappears when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or you die. If an ally of yours deals damage to the avatar, that ally summons another Avatar of Death. The new avatar appears in an unoccupied space as close to that ally as possible and targets only that ally with its attacks. You and your allies can each summon only one avatar as a consequence of this draw. A creature slain by an avatar can't be restored to life.

entries.name: Star
entries: Increase one of your ability scores by 2, to a maximum of 24.

entries.name: Sun
entries: A magic item (chosen by the DM) appears on your person. In addition, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} daily at dawn until you die.

entries.name: Talons
entries: Every magic item you wear or carry disintegrates. Artifacts in your possession vanish instead.

entries.name: Throne
entries: You gain proficiency and {@variantrule Expertise|SRD52} in your choice of {@skill History|SRD52}, {@skill Insight|SRD52}, {@skill Intimidation|SRD52}, or {@skill Persuasion|SRD52}. In addition, you gain rightful ownership of a small keep somewhere in the world. However, the keep is currently home to one or more monsters, which must be cleared out before you can claim the keep as yours.

entries.name: Void
entries: Your soul is drawn from your body and contained in an object in a place of the DM's choice. One or more powerful beings guard the place. While your soul is trapped in this way, your body is inert, ceases aging, and requires no food, air, or water. A {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell can't return your soul to your body, but the spell reveals the location of the object that holds your soul. You draw no more cards.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Discern whether someone is cheating ({@dc 10}), or win the game ({@dc 20})

item.name: Dimensional Shackles
entries: You can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to place these shackles on a creature that has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition. The shackles adjust to fit a creature of Small to Large size. The shackles prevent a creature bound by them from using any method of extradimensional movement, including teleportation or travel to a different plane of existence. They don't prevent the creature from passing through an interdimensional portal.

You and any creature you designate when you use the shackles can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to remove them. Once every 30 days, the bound creature can make a {@dc 30} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. On a successful check, the creature breaks free and destroys the shackles.

item.name: Diplomat's Pack
entries: A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: {@item Chest|SRD52}, {@item Fine Clothes|SRD52}, {@item Ink|SRD52}, 5 {@item Ink Pen|SRD52|Ink Pens}, {@item Lamp|SRD52}, 2 {@item Map or Scroll Case|SRD52|Map or Scroll Cases}, 4 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 5 sheets of {@item Paper|SRD52}, 5 sheets of {@item Parchment|SRD52}, {@item Perfume|SRD52}, and {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Charisma

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Apply makeup ({@dc 10})

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Costume|SRD52}

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Discern whether someone is cheating ({@dc 10}), or win the game ({@dc 20})

item.name: Dungeoneer's Pack
entries: A Dungeoneer's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Caltrops|SRD52}, {@item Crowbar|SRD52}, 2 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 10 days of {@item Rations|SRD52}, {@item Rope|SRD52}, {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}, 10 {@item Torch|SRD52|Torches}, and {@item Waterskin|SRD52}.

item.name: Dust of Disappearance
entries: This powder resembles fine sand. There is enough of it for one use. When you take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to throw the dust into the air, you and each creature and object within a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you have the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition for {@dice 2d4} minutes. The duration is the same for all subjects, and the dust is consumed when its magic takes effect. Immediately after an affected creature makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell, the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition ends for that creature.

item.name: Dust of Dryness
entries: This small packet contains {@dice 1d6 + 4} pinches of dust. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can sprinkle a pinch of the dust over water, turning up to a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} of water into one marble-sized pellet, which floats or rests near where the dust was sprinkled. The pellet's weight is negligible. A creature can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to smash the pellet against a hard surface, causing the pellet to shatter and release the water the dust absorbed. Doing so destroys the pellet and ends its magic.

As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can sprinkle a pinch of the dust on an Elemental within 5 feet of yourself that is composed mostly of water (such as a {@creature Water Elemental|SRD52} or a Water Weird). Such a creature exposed to a pinch of the dust makes a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw, taking {@damage 10d6} Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Dust of Sneezing and Choking
entries: Found in a small container, this powder resembles {@item Dust of Disappearance|SRD52}, and {@spell Identify|SRD52} reveals it to be such. There is enough of it for one use.

As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can throw the dust into the air, forcing yourself and every creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. Constructs, Elementals, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the save automatically.

On a failed save, a creature begins sneezing uncontrollably; it has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition and is suffocating. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. The effect also ends on any creature targeted by a {@spell Lesser Restoration|SRD52} spell.

item.name: Dwarven Thrower
item.reqAttune: by a Dwarf or a Creature Attuned to a {@item Belt of Dwarvenkind|SRD52}
entries: You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has {@itemProperty T|SRD52|Thrown} with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet. When you hit with a ranged attack using this weapon, it deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage, or an extra {@damage 2d8} Force damage if the target is a Giant. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand.

item.name: Efreeti Bottle
entries: When you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to remove the stopper of this painted brass bottle, a cloud of thick smoke flows out of it. At the end of your turn, the smoke disappears with a flash of harmless fire, and an {@creature Efreeti|SRD52} appears in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you.
The first time the bottle is opened, the DM rolls on the following table to determine what happens.

rows: The {@creature efreeti|SRD52} attacks you. After fighting for 5 rounds, the efreeti disappears, and the bottle loses its magic.

The {@creature efreeti|SRD52} understands your languages and obeys your commands for 1 hour, after which it returns to the bottle, and a new stopper contains it. The stopper can't be removed for 24 hours. The next two times the bottle is opened, the same effect occurs. If the bottle is opened a fourth time, the efreeti escapes and disappears, and the bottle loses its magic.
The {@creature efreeti|SRD52} understands your languages and can cast {@spell Wish|SRD52} once for you. It disappears when it grants the wish or after 1 hour, and the bottle loses its magic.

item.name: Elemental Gem, Blue Sapphire
entries: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to break the gem, an {@creature Air Elemental|SRD52} is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

item.name: Elemental Gem, Emerald
entries: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to break the gem, a {@creature Water Elemental|SRD52} is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

item.name: Elemental Gem, Red Corundum
entries: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to break the gem, a {@creature Fire Elemental|SRD52} is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

item.name: Elemental Gem, Yellow Diamond
entries: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to break the gem, an {@creature Earth Elemental|SRD52} is summoned, and the gem ceases to be magical. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

item.name: Elixir of Health
entries: When you drink this potion, you are cured of all magical contagions. In addition, the following conditions end on you: {@condition Blinded|SRD52}, {@condition Deafened|SRD52}, {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52}, and {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}.
The clear, red liquid has tiny bubbles of light in it.

item.name: Emblem
entries: For an Emblem to be an effective Holy Symbol, it must be borne on fabric (such as a tabard or banner) or a {@item Shield|SRD52}.

item.name: Entertainer's Pack
entries: An Entertainer's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Bedroll|SRD52}, {@item Bell|SRD52}, {@item Bullseye Lantern|SRD52}, 3 {@item Costume|SRD52|Costumes}, {@item Mirror|SRD52}, 8 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 9 days of {@item Rations|SRD52}, {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}, and {@item Waterskin|SRD52}.

item.name: Essence of Ether
entries: A creature subjected to Essence of Ether must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 8 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

item.name: Eversmoking Bottle
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can open or close this bottle.

Opening the bottle causes thick smoke to billow out, forming a cloud that fills a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the bottle. The area within the smoke is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52}.
Each minute the bottle remains open, the size of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} increases by 10 feet until it reaches its maximum size of 120 feet.

Closing the bottle causes the cloud to become fixed in place until it disperses after 10 minutes. A strong wind (such as that created by the {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52} spell) disperses the cloud after 1 minute.

item.name: Exotic Saddle
entries: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. An Exotic Saddle is required for riding an aquatic or a flying mount.

item.name: Explorer's Pack
entries: An Explorer's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Bedroll|SRD52}, 2 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 10 days of {@item Rations|SRD52}, {@item Rope|SRD52}, {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}, 10 {@item Torch|SRD52|Torches}, and {@item Waterskin|SRD52}.

item.name: Eyes of Charming
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. They have 3 charges. While wearing them, you can expend 1 or more charges to cast {@spell Charm Person|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}). For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You increase the spell's level by one for each additional charge you expend. The lenses regain all expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Eyes of Minute Seeing
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, your vision improves significantly out to a range of 1 foot, granting you {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} within that range and {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|SRD52}) checks made to examine something within that range.

item.name: Eyes of the Eagle
entries: These crystal lenses fit over the eyes. While wearing them, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks that rely on sight. In conditions of clear visibility, you can make out details of even extremely distant creatures and objects as small as 2 feet across.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Bronze Griffon (Rare)
entries: This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a {@creature Griffon|SRD52} for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Ebony Fly
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Ebony Fly (Rare)
entries: This ebony statuette, carved in the likeness of a horsefly, can become a {@creature Giant Fly|SRD52} for up to 12 hours and can be ridden as a mount. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Golden Lions
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Golden Lions (Rare)
entries: These gold statuettes of lions are always created in pairs. You can use one figurine or both simultaneously. Each can become a {@creature Lion|SRD52} for up to 1 hour. Once a lion has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Ivory Goats
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Ivory Goats (Rare)
entries: These ivory statuettes of goats are always created in sets of three. Each goat looks unique and functions differently from the others. Their properties are as follows:

items.name: Goat of Terror
entries: This figurine can become a {@creature Giant Goat|SRD52} for up to 3 hours. The goat can't attack, but you can (harmlessly) remove its horns and use them as weapons. One horn becomes a {@item +1 Lance|SRD52}, and the other becomes a {@item +2 Longsword|SRD52}. Removing a horn requires a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, and the weapons disappear and the horns return when the goat reverts to figurine form. While you ride the goat, any {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} creature that starts its turn within a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the goat must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute, until you are no longer riding the goat, or until the goat reverts to figurine form. The {@condition Frightened|SRD52} creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once it succeeds on the save, a creature is immune to this effect for the next 24 hours. Once the figurine has been used, it can't be used again until 15 days have passed.

items.name: Goat of Traveling
entries: This figurine can become a Large goat with the same statistics as a {@creature Riding Horse|SRD52}. It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. While it has charges, you can use it as often as you wish. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

items.name: Goat of Travail
entries: This figurine can become a {@creature Giant Goat|SRD52} for up to 3 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 30 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Marble Elephant
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Marble Elephant (Rare)
entries: This marble statuette resembles a trumpeting elephant. It can become an {@creature Elephant|SRD52} for up to 24 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Obsidian Steed
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Obsidian Steed (Very Rare)
entries: This polished obsidian horse can become a {@creature Nightmare|SRD52} for up to 24 hours. The nightmare fights only to defend itself. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.

The figurine has a {@chance 10} chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form. If you mount the nightmare while it is ignoring your orders, you and the nightmare are instantly transported to a random location on the plane of Hades, where the nightmare reverts to figurine form.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Onyx Dog
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Onyx Dog (Rare)
entries: This onyx statuette of a dog can become a {@creature Mastiff|SRD52} for up to 6 hours. The mastiff has an Intelligence of 8 and can speak Common. It also has {@sense Blindsight|SRD52} with a range of 60 feet. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Serpentine Owl (Rare)
entries: This serpentine statuette of an owl can become a {@creature Giant Owl|SRD52} for up to 8 hours. The owl can communicate telepathically with you at any range if you and it are on the same plane of existence. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.

item.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Silver Raven
entries: A {@item Figurine of Wondrous Power|SRD52} is a statuette small enough to fit in a pocket. If you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature specified in the figurine's description below. If the space where the creature would appear is occupied by other creatures or objects, or if there isn't enough space for the creature, the figurine doesn't become a creature.

The creature is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. If you issue no commands, the creature defends itself but takes no other actions.

The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form. It reverts to a figurine early if its creature form drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or if you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while touching the creature to make it revert to figurine form. When the creature becomes a figurine again, its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed, as specified below.

entries.name: Silver Raven (Uncommon)
entries: This silver statuette of a raven can become a {@creature Raven|SRD52} for up to 12 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed. While in raven form, the figurine grants you the ability to cast {@spell Animal Messenger|SRD52} on it.

item.name: Fine Clothes
entries: Fine Clothes are made of expensive fabrics and adorned with expertly crafted details. Some events and locations admit only people wearing these clothes.

item.name: Flask
entries: A Flask holds up to 1 pint.

item.name: Folding Boat
entries: This object appears as a wooden box that measures 12 inches long, 6 inches wide, and 6 inches deep. It weighs 4 pounds and floats. It can be opened to store items inside. This item also has three command words, each requiring a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to use:

items.name: First Command Word
entries: The box unfolds into a Rowboat.

items.name: Second Command Word
entries: The box unfolds into a Keelboat.

items.name: Third Command Word
entries: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard. Any objects in the vessel that can't fit inside the box remain outside the box as it folds. Any objects in the vessel that can fit inside the box do so.
When the box becomes a vessel, its weight becomes that of a normal vessel its size, and anything that was stored in the box remains in the boat.

Statistics for the {@item Rowboat|SRD52} and {@item Keelboat|SRD52} appear in the {@book Player's Handbook|SRD52}. If either vessel is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, the Folding Boat is destroyed.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Dexterity

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Mimic 10 or fewer words of someone else's handwriting ({@dc 15}), or duplicate a wax seal ({@dc 20})

item.name: Gauntlets of Ogre Power
entries: Your Strength score is 19 while you wear these gauntlets. They have no effect on you if your Strength is 19 or higher without them.

item.name: Gem of Brightness
entries: This prism has 50 charges. While you are holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and use one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

items.name: First Command Word
entries: The gem sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet. This effect doesn't expend a charge. It lasts until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to repeat the command word or until you use another function of the gem.

items.name: Second Command Word
entries: You expend 1 charge and cause the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

items.name: Third Command Word
entries: You expend 5 charges and cause the gem to flare with intense light in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} makes a saving throw as if struck by the beam created with the second command word.
When all of the gem's charges are expended, the gem becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 GP.

item.name: Gem of Seeing
entries: This gem has 3 charges. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can expend 1 charge. For the next 10 minutes, you have {@sense Truesight|SRD52} out to 120 feet when you peer through the gem.
The gem regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Glamoured Studded Leather
entries: While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}. You can also take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to cause the armor to assume the appearance of a normal set of clothing or some other kind of armor. You decide what it looks like—including color, style, and accessories—but the armor retains its normal bulk and weight. The illusory appearance lasts until you use this property again or doff the armor.

item.name: Glass Bottle
entries: A Glass Bottle holds up to 1½ pints.

item.name: Gloves of Missile Snaring
entries: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to reduce the damage by {@dice 1d10} plus your Dexterity modifier if you have a free hand. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.

item.name: Gloves of Swimming and Climbing
entries: While wearing these gloves, climbing and swimming don't cost you extra movement, and you gain a +5 bonus to Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) checks made to climb or swim.

item.name: Gloves of Thievery
entries: These gloves are imperceptible while worn. While wearing them, you gain a +5 bonus to Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) checks.

item.name: Goggles of Night
entries: While wearing these dark lenses, you have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} out to 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52}, wearing the goggles increases its range by 60 feet.

item.name: Gold Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Grappling Hook
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can throw the Grappling Hook at a railing, a ledge, or another catch within 50 feet of yourself, and the hook catches on if you succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) check. If you tied a Rope to the hook, you can then climb it.

item.name: Green Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Hat of Disguise
entries: While wearing this hat, you can cast the {@spell Disguise Self|SRD52} spell. The spell ends if the hat is removed.

item.name: Hat of Many Spells
item.reqAttune: by a wizard
entries: This pointed hat has the following properties.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: While holding the hat, you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|SRD52} for your Wizard spells. Any spell you cast using the hat gains a special Somatic component: you must reach into the hat and "pull" the spell out of it.

entries.name: Unknown Spell
entries: While holding the hat, you can try to cast a level 1+ spell you don't know. The spell must be on the Wizard spell list, it must be of a level you can cast, and it can't have Material components costing more than 1,000 GP. Once you decide on the spell, you must expend a spell slot of the spell's level. Then, to determine whether you cast the spell, make an Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}) check ({@dc 10} plus the spell's level). On a successful check, you cast the spell using its normal casting time, and you can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. On a failed check, you fail to cast the spell and a random effect occurs instead, determined by rolling on the following table.
Any spell you cast from the hat uses your spell save DC and spell attack bonus.

rows: You cast a random spell determined by rolling {@dice 1d10}: on a {@b 1}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} (enlarge effect); on a {@b 2}, {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} (reduce effect); on a {@b 3}, {@spell Faerie Fire|SRD52}; on a {@b 4}, {@spell Fireball|SRD52}; on a {@b 5}, {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52}; on a {@b 6}, {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} (cast on yourself); on a {@b 7}, {@spell Lightning Bolt|SRD52}; on an {@b 8}, {@spell Phantasmal Force|SRD52}; on a {@b 9}, {@spell Polymorph|SRD52}; on a {@b 10}, {@spell Stinking Cloud|SRD52}.
You have the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
A harmless swarm of butterflies fills a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} within 30 feet of yourself. The swarm disperses after 1 minute.

You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the object: on a {@b 1}, a vial of Acid; on a {@b 2}, a flask of Alchemist's Fire; on a {@b 3}, a Crowbar; on a {@b 4}, a lit Torch.
You suffer a bout of "magic sickness" and have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour.
You have the {@condition Petrified|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn.

You pull a nonmagical object out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the object: on a {@b 1}, a {@item Dagger|SRD52}; on a {@b 2}, a {@item Rope|SRD52} with a {@item Grappling Hook|SRD52} tied to one end; on a {@b 3}, a bag of {@item Caltrops|SRD52}; on a {@b 4}, a gem worth 50 GP.

A creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to you as possible. The creature isn't under your control and acts as it normally would, and it disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the creature: on a {@b 1}, a {@creature Camel|SRD52}; on a {@b 2}, a {@creature Constrictor Snake|SRD52}; on a {@b 3}, an {@creature Elephant|SRD52}; on a {@b 4}, a {@creature Mule|SRD52}.
A {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} {@creature Swarm of Bats|SRD52} flies out of the hat, occupies your space, and attacks you.
