A vertical, 10-foot-diameter, two-way portal to another plane of existence opens in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of you and remains open until the end of your next turn. The DM determines where it leads.

You pull a magic item out of the hat. Roll {@dice 1d6} to determine the item's rarity: on a {@b 1-3}, {@filter Common|items|rarity=Common}; on a {@b 4-5}, {@filter Uncommon|items|rarity=Uncommon}; on a {@b 6}, {@filter Rare|items|rarity=Rare}. The DM chooses the item, which disappears after 1 hour if it's not consumed or destroyed before then.

item.name: Headband of Intellect
entries: Your Intelligence score is 19 while you wear this headband. It has no effect on you if your Intelligence is 19 or higher without it.

item.name: Healer's Kit
entries: A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} creature that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} without needing to make a Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|SRD52}) check.

item.name: Helm of Brilliance
entries: This helm is set with {@dice 1d10} diamonds, {@dice 2d10} rubies, {@dice 3d10} fire opals, and {@dice 4d10} opals. Any gem pried from the helm crumbles to dust. When all the gems are removed or destroyed, the helm loses its magic.
You gain the following benefits while wearing the helm.

entries.name: Diamond Light
entries: As long as it has at least one diamond, the helm emits a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation}. When at least one Undead is within that area, the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} is filled with {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52}. Any Undead that starts its turn in that area takes {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage.

entries.name: Fire Opal Flames
entries: As long as the helm has at least one fire opal, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to cause one weapon you are holding to burst into flames. The flames emit {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 10 feet. The flames are harmless to you and the weapon. When you hit with an attack using the blazing weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage. The flames last until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to extinguish them or until you drop or stow the weapon.

entries.name: Ruby Resistance
entries: As long as the helm has at least one ruby, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Fire damage.

entries.name: Spells
entries: You can cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 18}), using one of the helm's gems of the specified type as a component: {@spell Daylight|SRD52} (opal), {@spell Fireball|SRD52} (fire opal), {@spell Prismatic Spray|SRD52} (diamond), or {@spell Wall of Fire|SRD52} (ruby). The gem is destroyed when the spell is cast and disappears from the helm.

entries.name: Taking Fire Damage
entries: Roll {@dice 1d20} if you are wearing the helm and take Fire damage as a result of failing a saving throw against a spell. On a roll of 1, the helm emits beams of light from its remaining gems and is then destroyed. Each creature within a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you must succeed on a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw or be struck by a beam, taking Radiant damage equal to the number of gems in the helm.

item.name: Helm of Comprehending Languages
entries: While wearing this helm, you can cast {@spell Comprehend Languages|SRD52} from it.

item.name: Helm of Telepathy
entries: While wearing this helm, you have telepathy with a range of 30 feet, and you can cast {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} or {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}) from the helm. Once either spell is cast from the helm, that spell can't be cast from it again until the next dawn.

item.name: Helm of Teleportation
entries: This helm has 3 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Teleport|SRD52} from it. The helm regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Intelligence

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Identify a plant ({@dc 10})

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Antitoxin|SRD52}, {@item Candle|SRD52}, {@item Healer's Kit|SRD52}, {@item Potion of Healing|SRD52}

item.name: Handy Haversack
entries: This backpack has a central pouch and two side pouches, each of which is an extradimensional space. Each side pouch can hold up to 200 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 25 cubic feet. The central pouch can hold up to 500 pounds of material, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. The haversack always weighs 5 pounds, regardless of its contents.

Retrieving an item from the haversack requires a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} (your choice). When you reach into the haversack for a specific item, the item is always magically on top.

If any of its pouches is overloaded, pierced, or torn, the haversack ruptures and is destroyed. If the haversack is destroyed, its contents are lost forever, although an Artifact always turns up again somewhere. If the haversack is turned inside out, its contents spill forth unharmed, and the haversack must be put right before it can be used again.
Each pouch of the haversack holds enough air for 10 minutes of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing the haversack inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Bag of Holding|SRD52}, {@item Portable Hole|SRD52}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

item.name: Holy Water
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}) or take {@damage 2d8} Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.

item.name: Hooded Lantern
entries: A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

item.name: Horn of Blasting
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow the horn, which emits a thunderous blast in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} that is audible out to 600 feet. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 5d8} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only. Glass or crystal objects in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} that aren't being worn or carried take {@damage 10d8} Thunder damage.
Each use of the horn's magic has a {@chance 20} chance of causing the horn to explode. The explosion deals {@damage 10d6} Force damage to the user and destroys the horn.

item.name: Horn of Valhalla, Brass
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the {@creature Berserker|SRD52} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
A brass horn summons 3 {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers}. To use the brass horn, you must have {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52} with all Simple weapons.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers} attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies and follow your commands.

item.name: Horn of Valhalla, Bronze
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the {@creature Berserker|SRD52} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
A bronze horn summons 4 {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers}. To use the bronze horn, you must have training with all Medium armor.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers} attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies and follow your commands.

item.name: Horn of Valhalla, Iron
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the {@creature Berserker|SRD52} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
A iron horn summons 5 {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers}. To use the iron horn, you must have {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52} with all Martial weapons.

If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers} attack you. If you meet the requirement, they are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies and follow your commands.

item.name: Horn of Valhalla, Silver
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the {@creature Berserker|SRD52} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.
A silver horn summons 2 {@creature Berserker|SRD52|Berserkers}. They are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies and follow your commands.

item.name: Horseshoes of a Zephyr
entries: These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.

While all four shoes are affixed to the hooves of a horse or similar creature, they allow the creature to move normally while floating 4 inches above a surface. This effect means the creature can cross or stand above nonsolid or unstable surfaces, such as water or lava. The creature leaves no tracks and ignores {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}. In addition, the creature can travel for up to 12 hours a day without gaining {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} levels from extended travel.

item.name: Horseshoes of Speed
entries: These horseshoes come in a set of four. As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can touch one of the horseshoes to the hoof of a horse or similar creature, whereupon the horseshoe affixes itself to the hoof. Removing a horseshoe also takes a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.
While all four horseshoes are attached to the same creature, its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is increased by 30 feet.

item.name: Hunting Trap
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can set a Hunting Trap, which is a sawtooth steel ring that snaps shut when a creature steps on a pressure plate in the center. The trap is affixed by a heavy chain to an immobile object, such as a tree or a spike driven into the ground. A creature that steps on the plate must succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage and have its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. Thereafter, until the creature breaks free of the trap, its movement is limited by the length of the chain (typically 3 feet). A creature can use its action to make a {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check, freeing itself or another creature within its reach on a success. Each failed check deals 1 Piercing damage to the trapped creature.

item.name: Immovable Rod
entries: This iron rod has a button on one end. You can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to press the button, which causes the rod to become magically fixed in place. Until you or another creature takes a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to push the button again, the rod doesn't move, even if it defies gravity. The rod can hold up to 8,000 pounds of weight. More weight causes the rod to deactivate and fall. A creature can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to make a {@dc 30} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check, moving the fixed rod up to 10 feet on a successful check.

item.name: Ink
entries: Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.

item.name: Ink Pen
entries: Using {@item Ink|SRD52}, an Ink Pen is used to write or draw.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Absorption
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}

While this pale lavender ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to cancel a spell of level 4 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Agility
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this deep-red sphere orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Awareness
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
While this dark-blue rhomboid orbits your head, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Fortitude
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this pink rhomboid orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Greater Absorption
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}

While this marbled lavender and green ellipsoid orbits your head, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to cancel a spell of level 8 or lower cast by a creature you can see. A canceled spell has no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. Once the stone has canceled 20 levels of spells, it burns out, turns dull gray, and loses its magic.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Insight
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this incandescent blue sphere orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Intellect
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled scarlet and blue sphere orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Leadership
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this marbled pink and green sphere orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Mastery
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} increases by 1 while this pale green prism orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Protection
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} while this dusty-rose prism orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Regeneration
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
You regain 15 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the end of each hour this pearly white spindle orbits your head if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Reserve
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}

This vibrant purple prism stores spells cast into it, holding them until you use them. The stone can store up to 4 levels of spells at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d4} levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 4 into the stone by touching it as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect, other than to be stored in the stone. If the stone can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While this stone orbits your head, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the stone is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Strength
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
Your Strength increases by 2, to a maximum of 20, while this pale blue rhomboid orbits your head.

item.name: Ioun Stone, Sustenance
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
You don't need to eat or drink while this clear spindle orbits your head.

item.name: Iron Bands
entries: This rusty iron sphere measures 3 inches in diameter and weighs 1 pound. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the sphere at a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. As the sphere moves through the air, it opens into a tangle of metal bands.

Make a ranged attack roll with an attack bonus equal to your Dexterity modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}. On a hit, the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to issue a command that releases it. Doing so or missing with the attack causes the bands to contract and become a sphere once more.

A creature that can touch the bands, including the one {@condition Restrained|SRD52}, can take an action to make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check to break the iron bands. On a successful check, the item is destroyed, and the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} creature is freed. On a failed check, any further attempts made by that creature automatically fail until 24 hours have elapsed.
Once the bands are used, they can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Iron Flask
entries: While holding this brass-stoppered iron flask, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to target a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself. If the flask is empty and the target is native to a plane of existence other than the one you're on, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw or be trapped in the flask. If the target has been trapped by the flask before, it has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the save. Once trapped, a creature remains in the flask until released. The flask can hold only one creature at a time. A creature trapped in the flask doesn't age and doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to remove the flask's stopper and release the creature in the flask. The creature then obeys your commands for 1 hour, understanding those commands even if it doesn't know the language in which the commands are given. If you issue no commands or give the creature a command that is likely to result in its death or imprisonment, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. At the end of the duration, the creature acts in accordance with its normal disposition and alignment.

An {@spell Identify|SRD52} spell reveals if the flask contains a creature, but the only way to determine the type of creature is to open the flask. A newly discovered Iron Flask might already contain a creature chosen by the DM.

item.name: Iron Pot
entries: An Iron Pot holds up to 1 gallon.

item.name: Iron Spike
entries: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can use a blunt object, such as a {@item Light Hammer|SRD52}, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a {@item Rope|SRD52} or {@item Chain|SRD52} to the Spike.

item.name: Iron Spikes
entries: Iron Spikes come in bundles of ten. As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can use a blunt object, such as a {@item Light Hammer|SRD52}, to hammer a spike into wood, earth, or a similar material. You can do so to jam a door shut or to then tie a {@item Rope|SRD52} or {@item Chain|SRD52} to the Spike.

item.name: Javelin of Lightning
entries: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

entries.name: Lightning Bolt
entries: When you throw this weapon at a target no farther than 120 feet from you, you can forgo making a ranged attack roll and instead turn the weapon into a bolt of lightning. This bolt forms a 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} between you and the target. The target and each other creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} (excluding you) makes a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 4d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand. This property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Jug
entries: A Jug holds up to 1 gallon.

item.name: Ladder
entries: A Ladder is 10 feet tall. You must climb to move up or down it.

item.name: Lamp
entries: A Lamp burns {@item Oil|SRD52} as fuel to cast {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet.

item.name: Lantern of Revealing
entries: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet. {@condition Invisible|SRD52} creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52}. You can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to lower the hood, reducing the lantern's light to {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} in a 5-foot radius.

item.name: Lock
entries: A Lock comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use {@item Thieves' Tools|SRD52} to pick this Lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check.

item.name: Spider's Sting
entries: A creature subjected to Lolth's Sting must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, the creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. The creature wakes up if it takes damage or if another creature takes an action to shake it awake.

item.name: Mace of Disruption
entries: When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with this magic weapon, that creature takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage. If the target has 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or fewer after taking this damage, it must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or be destroyed. On a successful save, the creature has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Light
entries: While you hold this weapon, it sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet.

item.name: Mace of Smiting
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. The bonus increases to +3 when you use the weapon to attack a Construct.

When you roll a 20 on an attack roll made with this weapon, the target takes an extra 7 Bludgeoning damage, or 14 Bludgeoning damage if it's a Construct. If a Construct has 25 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or fewer after taking this damage, it is destroyed.

item.name: Mace of Terror
entries: This magic weapon has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding the weapon, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and expend 1 charge to release a wave of terror from it. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. While {@condition Frightened|SRD52} in this way, a creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52|Opportunity Attacks}. For its action, it can use only the {@action Dash|SRD52} action or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If it has nowhere it can move, the creature can take the {@action Dodge|SRD52} action. At the end of each of its turns, a creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

item.name: Magnifying Glass
entries: A Magnifying Glass grants {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any ability check made to appraise or inspect a highly detailed item. Lighting a fire with a Magnifying Glass requires light as bright as sunlight to focus, tinder to ignite, and about 5 minutes for the fire to ignite.

item.name: Malice
entries: A creature subjected to Malice must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. The creature also has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way.

item.name: Manacles
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can use Manacles to bind an unwilling Small or Medium creature within 5 feet of yourself that has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52}, or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition if you succeed on a {@dc 13} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check. While bound, a creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls, and the creature is {@condition Restrained|SRD52} if the Manacles are attached to a chain or hook that is fixed in place. Escaping the Manacles requires a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check as an action. Bursting them requires a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check as an action.

Each set of Manacles comes with a key. Without the key, a creature can use {@item Thieves' Tools|SRD52} to pick the Manacles' lock with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check.

item.name: Mantle of Spell Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells while you wear this cloak.

item.name: Manual of Bodily Health
entries: This book contains health and diet tips, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Constitution increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Manual of Clay Golems
entries: This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a {@creature clay golem|SRD52}. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a {@i manual of golems} and attempts to read it takes {@damage 6d6} psychic damage.
To create a clay golem, you must spend 30 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 65,000 gp to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

item.name: Manual of Flesh Golems
entries: This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a {@creature flesh golem|SRD52}. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a {@i manual of golems} and attempts to read it takes {@damage 6d6} psychic damage.
To create a flesh golem, you must spend 60 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 50,000 gp to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

item.name: Manual of Gainful Exercise
entries: This book describes fitness exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Strength increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Manual of Iron Golems
entries: This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a {@creature iron golem|SRD52}. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a {@i manual of golems} and attempts to read it takes {@damage 6d6} psychic damage.
To create an iron golem, you must spend 120 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 100,000 gp to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

item.name: Manual of Quickness of Action
entries: This book contains coordination and balance exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Dexterity increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Manual of Stone Golems
entries: This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a {@creature stone golem|SRD52}. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a {@i manual of golems} and attempts to read it takes {@damage 6d6} psychic damage.
To create a stone golem, you must spend 90 days, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay 80,000 gp to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

item.name: Map
entries: If you consult an accurate Map, you gain a +5 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Survival|SRD52}) checks you make to find your way in the place represented on it.

item.name: Map or Scroll Case
entries: A {@item Map or Scroll Case|SRD52} holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

item.name: Medallion of Thoughts
entries: The medallion has 5 charges. While wearing it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}) from it. The medallion regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Midnight Tears
entries: A creature that ingests Midnight Tears suffers no effect until the stroke of midnight. Any effect that ends the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition neutralizes this poison. If the poison hasn't been neutralized before midnight, the creature makes a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Military Saddle
entries: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle. A Military Saddle gives {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any ability check you make to remain mounted.

item.name: Mirror
entries: A handheld steel Mirror is useful for personal cosmetics but also for peeking around corners and reflecting light as a signal.

item.name: Mirror of Life Trapping
entries: When this 4-foot-tall, 2-foot-wide mirror is viewed indirectly, its surface shows faint images of creatures. The mirror weighs 50 pounds, and it has AC 11, HP 10, {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Poison and Psychic damage, and {@variantrule Vulnerability|SRD52} to Bludgeoning damage. It shatters and is destroyed when reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

If the mirror is hanging on a vertical surface and you are within 5 feet of it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and use a command word to activate it. It remains activated until you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and repeat the command word to deactivate it.

Any creature other than you that sees its reflection in the activated mirror while within 30 feet of the mirror must succeed on a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw or be trapped, along with anything it is wearing or carrying, in one of the mirror's twelve extradimensional cells. A creature that knows the mirror's nature makes the save with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52}, and Constructs succeed on the save automatically.

An extradimensional cell is an infinite expanse filled with thick fog that reduces visibility to 10 feet. Creatures trapped in the mirror's cells don't age, and they don't need to eat, drink, or sleep. A creature trapped within a cell can escape using magic that permits planar travel. Otherwise, the creature is confined to the cell until freed.

If the mirror traps a creature but its twelve extradimensional cells are already occupied, the mirror frees one trapped creature at random to accommodate the new prisoner. A freed creature appears in an unoccupied space within sight of the mirror but facing away from it. If the mirror is shattered, all creatures it contains are freed and appear in unoccupied spaces near it.

While within 5 feet of the mirror, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to name one creature trapped in it or call out a particular cell by number. The creature named or contained in the named cell appears as an image on the mirror's surface. You and the creature can then communicate.

In a similar way, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and use a second command word to free one creature trapped in the mirror. The freed creature appears, along with its possessions, in the unoccupied space nearest to the mirror and facing away from it.

Placing the mirror inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Bag of Holding|SRD52}, Portable Hole, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Plot a course ({@dc 10}), or determine position by stargazing ({@dc 15})

item.name: Necklace of Adaptation
entries: While wearing this necklace, you can breathe normally in any environment, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition.

item.name: Necklace of Fireballs
entries: This necklace has {@dice 1d6 + 3} beads hanging from it. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to detach a bead and throw it up to 60 feet away. When it reaches the end of its trajectory, the bead detonates as a level 3 {@spell Fireball|SRD52} (save {@dc 15}).
You can hurl multiple beads, or even the whole necklace, at one time. When you do so, increase the damage of the Fireball by {@damage 1d6} for each bead after the first (maximum {@dice 12d6}).

item.name: Necklace of Prayer Beads
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
entries: This necklace has {@dice 1d4 + 2} magic beads made from aquamarine, black pearl, or topaz. It also has many nonmagical beads made from stones such as amber, bloodstone, citrine, coral, jade, pearl, or quartz. If a magic bead is removed from the necklace, that bead loses its magic.

Six types of magic beads exist. The DM decides the type of each bead on the necklace or determines it randomly by rolling on the table below. A necklace can have more than one bead of the same type. To use one, you must be wearing the necklace. Each bead contains a spell that you can cast from it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} (using your spell save DC if a save is necessary). Once a magic bead's spell is cast, that bead can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Net
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a Net. Target a creature you can see within 15 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until it escapes. The target succeeds automatically if it is Huge or larger.

To escape, the target or a creature within 5 feet of it must take an action to make a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check, freeing the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} creature on a success. Destroying the Net (AC 10; 5 HP; {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage) also frees the target, ending the effect.

item.name: Marvelous Pigments
entries: This fine wooden box contains {@dice 1d4} pots of pigment and a brush (weighing 1 pound in total). Using the brush and expending 1 pot of pigment, you can paint any number of three-dimensional objects and terrain features (such as walls, doors, trees, flowers, weapons, webs, and pits), provided these elements are all confined to a 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube}. The effort takes 10 minutes (regardless of the number of elements you create), during which time you must remain in the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube}, and requires {@status Concentration|SRD52}. If your {@status Concentration|SRD52} is broken or you leave the {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} before the work is done, all the painted elements vanish, and the pot of pigment is wasted.

When the work is done, all the painted objects and terrain features become real. Thus, painting a door on a wall creates an actual door, which can be opened to whatever is beyond. Painting a pit creates a real pit, the entire depth of which must lie within the 20-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube}.

No object created by a pot of pigment can have a value greater than 25 GP, and the total value of all objects created by a pot of pigment can't exceed 500 GP. If you paint objects of greater value (such as a large pile of gold), they look authentic, but close inspection reveals they're made from paste, cookies, or some other worthless material.
If you paint a form of energy such as fire or lightning, the energy dissipates as soon as you complete the painting, doing no harm.

item.name: Oil
entries: You can douse a creature, object, or space with Oil or use it as fuel, as detailed below.

entries.name: Dousing a Creature or an Object
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing an Oil flask. Target one creature or object within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}) or be covered in oil. If the target takes Fire damage before the oil dries (after 1 minute), the target takes an extra 5 Fire damage from burning oil.

entries.name: Dousing a Space
entries: You can take the {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to pour an Oil flask on level ground to cover a 5-foot-square area within 5 feet of yourself. If lit, the oil burns until the end of the turn 2 rounds from when the oil was lit (or 12 seconds) and deals 5 Fire damage to any creature that enters the area or ends its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

entries.name: Fuel
entries: Oil serves as fuel for Lamps and Lanterns. Once lit, a flask of Oil burns for 6 hours in a Lamp or Lantern. That duration doesn't need to be consecutive; you can extinguish the burning Oil (as a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action) and rekindle it again until it has burned for a total of 6 hours.

item.name: Oil of Etherealness
entries: One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the {@spell Etherealness|SRD52} spell for 1 hour.
Beads of this cloudy, gray oil form on the outside of its container and quickly evaporate.

item.name: Oil of Sharpness
entries: One vial of this oil can coat one Melee weapon or twenty pieces of ammunition, but only ammunition and Melee weapons that are nonmagical and deal Slashing or Piercing damage are affected. Applying the oil takes 1 minute, after which the oil magically seeps into whatever it coats, turning the coated weapon into a +3 Weapon or the coated ammunition into +3 Ammunition.
This clear, gelatinous oil sparkles with tiny, ultrathin silver shards.

item.name: Oil of Slipperiness
entries: One vial of this oil can cover one Medium or smaller creature, along with the equipment it's wearing and carrying (one additional vial is required for each size category above Medium). Applying the oil takes 10 minutes. The affected creature then gains the effect of the {@spell Freedom of Movement|SRD52} spell for 8 hours.

Alternatively, the oil can be poured on the ground as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, where it covers a 10-foot square, duplicating the effect of the {@spell Grease|SRD52} spell in that area for 8 hours.
This sticky, black unguent is thick and heavy, but it flows quickly when poured.

item.name: Oil of Taggit
entries: A creature subjected to Oil of Taggit must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 24 hours. The creature also has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition while {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way. It wakes up if it takes damage.

item.name: Dragon Orb
entries: Long ago, in the Dragonlance setting, elves and humans waged a terrible war against chromatic dragons. When the world seemed doomed, the wizards of the Towers of High Sorcery came together and forged five Orbs of Dragonkind to help defeat the dragons. One orb was taken to each of the five towers, and there they were used to speed the war toward a victorious end. The wizards used the orbs to lure dragons to them, then destroyed the dragons with powerful magic.

As the Towers of High Sorcery fell in later ages, the orbs were destroyed or faded into legend, and only three are thought to survive. Their magic has been warped over the centuries. Their primary purpose of calling dragons still functions, but they also allow some measure of control over dragons.

Each orb contains the essence of an evil dragon, a presence that resents any attempt to coax magic from it. Those who try to wield an orb's magic but lack sufficient force of personality might find themselves under the orb's control.
An orb is an etched crystal globe about 10 inches in diameter. When used, it grows to about 20 inches in diameter, and mist swirls inside it.

While attuned to an orb, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to peer into the orb's depths. You must then make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, you control the orb for as long as you remain attuned to it. On a failed save, the orb imposes the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition on you for as long as you remain attuned to it.

While you are {@condition Charmed|SRD52} by the orb, you can't voluntarily end your {@variantrule Attunement|SRD52} to it, and the orb casts {@spell Suggestion|SRD52} on you at will (save {@dc 18}), urging you to work toward the evil ends it desires. The dragon essence within the orb might want many things: the annihilation of a particular society or organization, freedom from the orb, to spread suffering in the world, to advance the worship of {@book Tiamat|SRD52|8|Tiamat}, or something else the DM decides.

entries.name: Random Properties
entries: An Orb of Dragonkind has the following random properties:

entries.name: Spells
entries: The orb has 7 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 3} expended charges daily at dawn. If you control the orb, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Call Dragons
entries: While you control the orb, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to cause the orb to issue a telepathic call that extends in all directions for 40 miles. Chromatic dragons in range feel compelled to come to the orb as soon as possible by the most direct route. Dragon deities such as {@book Tiamat|SRD52|8|Tiamat} are unaffected by this call. Chromatic dragons drawn to the orb might be {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} toward you for compelling them against their will. Once you have used this property, it can't be used again for 1 hour.

entries.name: Destroying an Orb
entries: An Orb of Dragonkind has AC 20 and is destroyed if it takes damage from a +3 Weapon or a {@spell Disintegrate|SRD52} spell. Nothing else can harm it.

item.name: Pale Tincture
entries: A creature subjected to Pale Tincture must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or take 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage and have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition. The {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} creature repeats the save every 24 hours, taking 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage on a failed save. The damage the poison deals can't be healed by any means while the creature remains {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}. After seven successful saves against the poison, the creature is no longer {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}.

item.name: Paper
entries: One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.

item.name: Parchment
entries: One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.

item.name: Pearl of Power
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: While this pearl is on your person, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to regain one expended spell slot of level 3 or lower. Once you use the pearl, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Perfume
entries: Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|SRD52}) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.

item.name: Periapt of Health
entries: While wearing this pendant, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to regain {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.
In addition, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition while you wear this pendant.

item.name: Periapt of Proof against Poison
entries: This delicate silver chain has a brilliant-cut black gem pendant. While you wear it, you have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition and Poison damage.

item.name: Periapt of Wound Closure
entries: While wearing this pendant, you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Life Preservation
entries: Whenever you make a {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|SRD52}, you can change a roll of 9 or lower to a 10, turning a failed save into a successful one.

entries.name: Natural Healing Boost
entries: Whenever you roll a {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52|Hit Point Die} to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, double the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} it restores.

item.name: Philter of Love
entries: The next time you see a creature within 10 minutes after drinking this philter, you are {@condition charmed|SRD52} by that creature and have the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition for 1 hour.
This rose-hued, effervescent liquid contains one easy-to-miss bubble shaped like a heart.

item.name: Pipes of Haunting
entries: These pipes have 3 charges and regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to play them and expend 1 charge to create an eerie, spellbinding tune. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the save repeats it at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on its save is immune to the effect of these pipes for 24 hours.

item.name: Pipes of the Sewers
entries: While these pipes are on your person, ordinary {@creature rat|SRD52|rats} and {@creature giant rat|SRD52|giant rats} are {@variantrule Indifferent [Attitude]|SRD52|Indifferent} toward you and won't attack you unless you threaten or harm them.

The pipes have 3 charges and regain {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. If you play the pipes as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to expend 1 to 3 charges, calling forth one {@creature Swarm of Rats|SRD52} with each expended charge if enough rats are within half a mile of you to be called in this fashion (as determined by the DM). If there aren't enough rats to form a swarm, the charge is wasted. Called swarms move toward the music by the shortest available route but aren't under your control otherwise.

Whenever a Swarm of Rats that isn't under another creature's control comes within 30 feet of you while you are playing the pipes, the swarm makes a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours. On a failed save, the swarm is swayed by the pipes' music and becomes {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies for as long as you continue to play the pipes each round as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. A {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} swarm obeys your commands. If you issue no commands to a {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} swarm, it defends itself but otherwise takes no actions. If a {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} swarm starts its turn more than 30 feet away from you, your control over that swarm ends, and the swarm behaves as it normally would and can't be swayed by the pipes' music for the next 24 hours.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Discern whether someone is cheating ({@dc 10}), or win the game ({@dc 20})

items.name: Ability:
entries: Intelligence

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Detect a poisoned object ({@dc 10})

items.name: Craft:
entries: {@item Basic Poison|SRD52}

item.name: Pole
entries: A Pole is 10 feet long. You can use it to touch something up to 10 feet away. If you must make a Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check as part of a High or {@variantrule Long Jump|SRD52}, you can use the Pole to vault, giving yourself {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check.

item.name: Portable Hole
entries: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to unfold a Portable Hole and place it on or against a solid surface, whereupon the Portable Hole creates an extradimensional hole 10 feet deep. The cylindrical space within the hole exists on a different plane of existence, so it can't be used to create open passages. Any creature inside an open Portable Hole can exit the hole by climbing out of it.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to close a Portable Hole by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up. Folding the cloth closes the hole, and any creatures or objects within remain in the extradimensional space. No matter what's in it, the hole weighs next to nothing.

If the hole is folded up, a creature within the hole's extradimensional space can take an action to make a {@dc 10} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. On a successful check, the creature forces its way out and appears within 5 feet of the Portable Hole. A closed Portable Hole holds enough air for 1 hour of breathing, divided by the number of breathing creatures inside.

Placing a Portable Hole inside an extradimensional space created by a {@item Bag of Holding|SRD52}, {@item Heward's Handy Haversack|SRD52}, or similar item instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where the one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10 feet of the gate and not behind {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} is sucked through it and deposited in a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

item.name: Portable Ram
entries: You can use a Portable Ram to break down doors. When doing so, you gain a +4 bonus to the Strength check. One other character can help you use the ram, giving you {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on this check.

item.name: Potion of Acid Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Animal Friendship
entries: When you drink this potion, you can cast the level 3 version of the {@spell Animal Friendship|SRD52} spell (save {@dc 13}).
Agitating this potion's muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird feather, a cat claw, or a squirrel hair.

item.name: Potion of Clairvoyance
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Clairvoyance|SRD52} spell (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
An eyeball bobs in this potion's yellowish liquid but vanishes when the potion is opened.

item.name: Potion of Climbing
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} for 1 hour. During this time, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) checks to climb.
This potion is separated into brown, silver, and gray layers resembling bands of stone. Shaking the bottle fails to mix the colors.

item.name: Potion of Cloud Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 27 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a cloud giant.

item.name: Potion of Cold Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Diminution
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} spell for {@dice 1d4} hours (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
The red in the potion's liquid continuously contracts to a tiny bead and then expands to color the clear liquid around it. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

item.name: Potion of Fire Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 25 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a fire giant.

item.name: Potion of Fire Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Flying
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} for 1 hour and can hover. If you're in the air when the potion wears off, you fall unless you have some other means of staying aloft.
This potion's clear liquid floats at the top of its container and has cloudy white impurities drifting in it.

item.name: Potion of Force Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Frost Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a frost giant.

item.name: Potion of Gaseous Form
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Gaseous Form|SRD52} spell for 1 hour (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required) or until you end the effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.
This potion's container seems to hold fog that moves and pours like water.

item.name: Potion of Greater Healing
entries: You regain {@dice 4d4 + 4} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

item.name: Potion of Growth
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the "enlarge" effect of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} spell for 10 minutes (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
The red in the potion's liquid continuously expands from a tiny bead to color the clear liquid around it and then contracts. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.

item.name: Potion of Healing
entries: This potion is a magic item. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can drink it or administer it to another creature within 5 feet of yourself. The creature that drinks the magical red fluid in this vial regains {@dice 2d4 + 2} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

item.name: Potion of Heroism
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain 10 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the {@spell Bless|SRD52} spell (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.

item.name: Potion of Hill Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 21 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a hill giant.

item.name: Potion of Invisibility
entries: This potion's container looks empty but feels as though it holds liquid. When you drink the potion, you have the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. The effect ends early if you make an attack roll, deal damage, or cast a spell.

item.name: Potion of Invulnerability
entries: For 1 minute after you drink this potion, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to all damage.
This potion's syrupy liquid looks like liquefied iron.

item.name: Potion of Lightning Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Longevity
entries: When you drink this potion, your physical age is reduced by {@dice 1d6 + 6} years, to a minimum of 13 years. Each time you subsequently drink a Potion of Longevity, there is 10 percent cumulative chance that you instead age by {@dice 1d6 + 6} years.
Suspended in this amber liquid is a tiny heart that, against all reason, is still beating. These ingredients vanish when the potion is opened.

item.name: Potion of Mind Reading
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52} spell (save {@dc 13}) for 10 minutes (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required).
This potion's dense, purple liquid has an ovoid cloud of pink floating in it.

item.name: Potion of Necrotic Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Poison
entries: This concoction looks, smells, and tastes like a {@item Potion of Healing|SRD52} or another beneficial potion. However, it is actually poison masked by illusion magic. {@spell Identify|SRD52} reveals its true nature.
If you drink this potion, you take {@damage 4d6} Poison damage and must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour.

item.name: Potion of Poison Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Psychic Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Radiant Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Speed
entries: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the {@spell Haste|SRD52} spell for 1 minute (no {@status Concentration|SRD52} required) without suffering the wave of lethargy that typically occurs when the effect ends.
This potion's yellow fluid is streaked with black and swirls on its own.

item.name: Potion of Stone Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 23 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a stone giant.

item.name: Potion of Storm Giant Strength
entries: When you drink this potion, your Strength score changes to 29 for 1 hour. The potion has no effect on you if your Strength is equal to or greater than that score.
This potion's transparent liquid has floating in it a sliver of fingernail from a storm giant.

item.name: Potion of Superior Healing
entries: You regain {@dice 8d4 + 8} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

item.name: Potion of Supreme Healing
entries: You regain {@dice 10d4 + 20} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} when you drink this potion. The potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

item.name: Potion of Thunder Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Potion of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Potion of Vitality
entries: When you drink this potion, it removes any {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} levels you have and ends the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition on you. For the next 24 hours, you regain the maximum number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} for any {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52|Hit Point Die} you spend.
This potion's crimson liquid regularly pulses with dull light, calling to mind a heartbeat.

item.name: Potion of Water Breathing
entries: You can breathe underwater for 24 hours after drinking this potion.
This potion's cloudy green fluid smells of the sea and has a jellyfish-like bubble floating in it.

item.name: Pouch
entries: A Pouch holds up to 6 pounds within one-fifth of a cubic foot.

item.name: Priest's Pack
entries: A Priest's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Blanket|SRD52}, {@item Holy Water|SRD52}, {@item Lamp|SRD52}, 7 days of {@item Rations|SRD52}, {@item Robe|SRD52}, and {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}.

item.name: Purple Worm Poison
entries: A creature subjected to Purple Worm Poison makes a {@dc 21} Constitution saving throw, taking 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Feather Token, Anchor
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to touch the token to a boat or ship. For the next 24 hours, the vessel can't be moved by any means. Touching the token to the vessel again ends the effect. When the effect ends, the token disappears.

item.name: Feather Token, Bird
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to toss the token 5 feet into the air. The token disappears and an enormous, multicolored bird takes its place. The bird has the statistics of a {@creature Roc|SRD52}, but it can't attack. It obeys your simple commands and can carry up to 500 pounds while flying at its maximum speed (16 miles per hour for a maximum of 144 miles per day, with a 1-hour rest for every 3 hours of flying) or 1,000 pounds at half that speed. The bird disappears after flying its maximum distance for a day or if it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. You can dismiss the bird as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.

item.name: Feather Token, Fan
entries: This object looks like a feather.

If you are on a boat or ship, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to toss the token up to 10 feet in the air. The token disappears, and a giant flapping fan takes its place. The fan floats and creates a strong wind. This wind can fill the sails of one ship, increasing its speed by 5 miles per hour for 8 hours. You can dismiss the fan as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.

item.name: Feather Token, Swan Boat
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to touch the token to a body of water at least 60 feet in diameter. The token disappears, and a 50-foot-long, 20-foot-wide boat shaped like a swan takes its place. The boat is self-propelled and moves across water at a speed of 6 miles per hour. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action while on the boat to command it to move or to turn up to 90 degrees. The boat remains for 24 hours and then disappears. You can dismiss the boat as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action.

item.name: Feather Token, Tree
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You must be outdoors to use this token. You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to touch it to an unoccupied space on the ground. The token disappears, and in its place a nonmagical oak tree springs into existence. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius.

item.name: Feather Token, Whip
entries: This object looks like a feather.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to throw the token to a point within 10 feet of yourself. The token disappears, and a floating whip takes its place. You can then take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to make a melee spell attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip, with an attack bonus of +9. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 1d6 + 5} Force damage.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can direct the whip to fly up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 10 feet of the whip. The whip disappears after 1 hour, when you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to dismiss it, or when you die or have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

item.name: Quarterstaff of the Acrobat
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

While holding this weapon, you can cause it to emit green {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} out to 10 feet, either as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} or after you roll {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52}, or you can extinguish the light as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}.

While holding this weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod (for ease of storage) or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff; the weapon will elongate only as far as the surrounding space allows.
In certain forms, the weapon has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only)
entries: While holding this weapon, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) checks.

entries.name: Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only)
entries: When you are hit by an attack while holding the weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to twirl the weapon around you, gaining a +5 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} against the triggering attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You can't use this property again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only)
entries: This weapon has {@itemProperty T|SRD52|Thrown} with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

item.name: Quiver
entries: A Quiver holds up to 20 Arrows.

item.name: Efficient Quiver
entries: Each of the quiver's three compartments connects to an extradimensional space that allows the quiver to hold numerous items while never weighing more than 2 pounds. The shortest compartment can hold up to 60 {@item Arrow|SRD52|Arrows}, {@item Bolt|SRD52|Bolts}, or similar objects. The midsize compartment holds up to 18 {@item Javelin|SRD52|Javelins} or similar objects. The longest compartment holds up to 6 long objects, such as bows, {@item Quarterstaff|SRD52|Quarterstaff's}, or {@item Spear|SRD52|Spears}.
You can draw any item the quiver contains as if doing so from a regular quiver or scabbard.

item.name: Rations
entries: Rations consist of travel-ready food, including jerky, dried fruit, hardtack, and nuts. See "{@hazard Malnutrition|SRD52}" for the risks of not eating.

item.name: Red Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Reliquary
entries: For a Reliquary to be an effective Holy Symbol, it must be held.

item.name: Riding Saddle
entries: A saddle comes with a bit, a bridle, reins, and any other equipment needed to use the saddle.

item.name: Ring of Acid Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Animal Influence
entries: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can expend 1 charge to cast one of the following spells (save {@dc 13}) from it:

item.name: Ring of Cold Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Djinni Summoning
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon a particular {@creature Djinni|SRD52} from the Elemental Plane of Air. The djinni appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 120 feet of yourself. It remains as long as you maintain {@status Concentration|SRD52}, to a maximum of 1 hour, or until it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

While summoned, the djinni is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies, and it obeys your commands. If you fail to command it, the djinni defends itself against attackers but takes no other actions.
After the djinni departs, it can't be summoned again for 24 hours, and the ring becomes nonmagical if the djinni dies.
Rings of Djinni Summoning are often created by the djinn they summon and given to mortals as gifts of friendship or tokens of esteem.

item.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Air)
entries: The Ring of Elemental Command (air) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you.

items.name: Elemental Compulsion
entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Air
entries: You know Auran, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Lightning damage, and you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} and can hover.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The ring has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: {@spell Chain Lightning|SRD52} (3 charges), {@spell Feather Fall|SRD52} (0 charges), {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52} (2 charges), {@spell Wind Wall|SRD52} (1 charge)

item.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Earth)
entries: The Ring of Elemental Command (earth) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Earth. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you.

items.name: Elemental Compulsion
entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Earth
entries: You know Terran, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Acid damage. Terrain composed of rubble, rocks, or dirt isn't {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} for you. In addition, you can move through solid earth or rock as if those areas were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} without disturbing the matter through which you pass. If you end your turn in solid earth or rock, you are shunted out to the nearest unoccupied space you last occupied.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The ring has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: {@spell Earthquake|SRD52} (5 charges), {@spell Stone Shape|SRD52} (2 charges), {@spell Stoneskin|SRD52} (3 charges), {@spell Wall of Stone|SRD52} (3 charges)

item.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Fire)
entries: The Ring of Elemental Command (fire) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Fire. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you.

items.name: Elemental Compulsion
entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Fire
entries: You know Ignan, and you have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Fire damage.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The ring has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: {@spell Burning Hands|SRD52} (1 charge), {@spell Fireball|SRD52} (2 charges), {@spell Fire Storm|SRD52} (4 charges), {@spell Wall of Fire|SRD52} (3 charges)

item.name: Ring of Elemental Command (Water)
entries: The Ring of Elemental Command (water) is linked to the Elemental Plane of Water. Every Ring of Elemental Command has the following two properties:

items.name: Elemental Bane
entries: While wearing the ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against Elementals and they have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you.

items.name: Elemental Compulsion
entries: While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to compel an Elemental you see within 60 feet of yourself. The Elemental makes a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Elemental has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start your next turn, and you determine what it does with its move and action on its next turn.

entries.name: Elemental Focus
entries: While wearing the ring, you benefit from additional properties corresponding to the ring's linked Elemental Plane:

items.name: Water
entries: You know Aquan, you gain a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52} of 60 feet, and you can breathe underwater.

entries.name: Spellcasting
entries: The ring has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can cast a spell from it. A spell cast from the ring has a save DC of 18. Choose the spell from the following list: {@spell Create or Destroy Water|SRD52} (1 charge), {@spell Ice Storm|SRD52} (2 charges), {@spell Tsunami|SRD52} (5 charges), {@spell Wall of Ice|SRD52} (3 charges), {@spell Water Walk|SRD52} (2 charges)

item.name: Ring of Evasion
entries: This ring has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. When you fail a Dexterity saving throw while wearing the ring, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to expend 1 charge to succeed on that save instead.

item.name: Ring of Feather Falling
entries: When you fall while wearing this ring, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling.

item.name: Ring of Fire Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Force Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Free Action
entries: While you wear this ring, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52} doesn't cost you extra movement. In addition, magic can neither reduce any of your Speeds nor cause you to have the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition.

item.name: Ring of Invisibility
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to give yourself the {@condition Invisible|SRD52} condition. You remain {@condition Invisible|SRD52} until the ring is removed or until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to become visible again.

item.name: Ring of Jumping
entries: While wearing this ring, you can cast {@spell Jump|SRD52} from it, but can target only yourself when you do so.

item.name: Ring of Lightning Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Mind Shielding
