entries: While wearing this ring, you are immune to magic that allows other creatures to read your thoughts, determine whether you are lying, know your alignment, or know your creature type. Creatures can telepathically communicate with you only if you allow it.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to cause the ring to become imperceptible until you take another {@action Magic|SRD52} action to make it perceptible, until you remove the ring, or until you die.

If you die while wearing the ring, your soul enters it, unless it already houses a soul. You can remain in the ring or depart for the afterlife. As long as your soul is in the ring, you can telepathically communicate with any creature wearing it. A wearer can't prevent this telepathic communication.

item.name: Ring of Necrotic Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Poison Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Protection
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} and saving throws while wearing this ring.

item.name: Ring of Psychic Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Radiant Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Regeneration
entries: While wearing this ring, you regain {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} every 10 minutes if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}. If you lose a body part, the ring causes the missing part to regrow and return to full functionality after {@dice 1d6 + 1} days if you have at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} the whole time.

item.name: Ring of Shooting Stars
entries: You can cast {@spell Dancing Lights|SRD52} or {@spell Light|SRD52} from the ring.
The ring has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend its charges to use the properties below.

entries.name: Faerie Fire
entries: You can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Faerie Fire|SRD52} from the ring.

entries.name: Lightning Spheres
entries: You can expend 2 charges as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to create up to four 3-foot-diameter spheres of lightning.

Each sphere appears in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet of yourself. The spheres last as long as you maintain {@status Concentration|SRD52}, up to 1 minute. Each sphere sheds {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can move each sphere up to 30 feet, but no farther than 120 feet away from yourself. The first time the sphere comes within 5 feet of a creature other than you that isn't behind {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover}, the sphere discharges lightning at that creature and disappears. That creature makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes Lightning damage based on the number of spheres you created, as shown in the following table. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

entries.name: Shooting Stars
entries: You can expend 1 to 3 charges as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. For every charge you expend, you launch a glowing mote of light from the ring at a point you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} originating from that point is showered in sparks and makes a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 5d4} Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Ring of Spell Storing
entries: This ring stores spells cast into it, holding them until the attuned wearer uses them. The ring can store up to 5 levels worth of spells at a time. When found, it contains {@dice 1d6 - 1} levels of stored spells chosen by the DM.

Any creature can cast a spell of level 1 through 5 into the ring by touching the ring as the spell is cast. The spell has no effect other than to be stored in the ring. If the ring can't hold the spell, the spell is expended without effect. The level of the slot used to cast the spell determines how much space it uses.

While wearing this ring, you can cast any spell stored in it. The spell uses the slot level, spell save DC, spell attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the original caster but is otherwise treated as if you cast the spell. The spell cast from the ring is no longer stored in it, freeing up space.

item.name: Ring of Spell Turning
entries: While wearing this ring, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells. If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.

item.name: Ring of Swimming
entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52} of 40 feet while wearing this ring.

item.name: Ring of Telekinesis
entries: While wearing this ring, you can cast {@spell Telekinesis|SRD52} from it.

item.name: Ring of the Ram
entries: This ring has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 to 3 charges to make a ranged spell attack against one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The ring produces a spectral ram's head and makes its attack roll with a +7 bonus. On a hit, for each charge you spend, the target takes {@damage 2d10} Force damage and is pushed 5 feet away from you.

Alternatively, you can expend 1 to 3 of the ring's charges as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to try to break a nonmagical object you can see within 60 feet of yourself that isn't being worn or carried. The ring makes a Strength check with a +5 bonus for each charge you spend.

item.name: Ring of Three Wishes
entries: While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast {@spell Wish|SRD52} from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

item.name: Ring of Thunder Resistance
entries: {#itemEntry Ring of Resistance|SRD52}

item.name: Ring of Warmth
entries: If you take Cold damage while wearing this ring, the ring reduces the damage you take by {@dice 2d8}.
In addition, while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower.

item.name: Ring of Water Walking
entries: While wearing this ring, you cast {@spell Water Walk|SRD52} from it, targeting only yourself.

item.name: Ring of X-ray Vision
entries: While wearing this ring, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to gain X-ray vision with a range of 30 feet for 1 minute. To you, solid objects within that radius appear transparent and don't prevent light from passing through them. The vision can penetrate 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, or up to 3 feet of wood or dirt. Thicker substances or a thin sheet of lead block the vision.
Whenever you use the ring again before taking a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or gain 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level.

item.name: Robe
entries: A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.

item.name: Robe of Eyes
entries: This robe is adorned with eyelike patterns. While you wear the robe, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: All-Around Vision
entries: The robe gives you {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks that rely on sight.

items.name: Special Senses
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} and {@sense Truesight|SRD52}, both with a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Drawbacks
entries: A {@spell Light|SRD52} spell cast on the robe or a {@spell Daylight|SRD52} spell cast within 5 feet of the robe gives you the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of your turns, you make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 11} for Light or {@dc 15} for Daylight), ending the condition on yourself on a success.

item.name: Robe of Scintillating Colors
entries: This robe has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While you wear it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and expend 1 charge to cause the garment to display a shifting pattern of dazzling hues until the end of your next turn. During this time, the robe sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet, and creatures that can see you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against you. Any creature in the {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the effect ends.

item.name: Robe of Stars
entries: This black or dark-blue robe is embroidered with small white or silver stars. You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it.

Six stars, located on the robe's upper-front portion, are particularly large. While wearing this robe, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of {@spell Magic Missile|SRD52}. Daily at dusk, {@dice 1d6} removed stars reappear on the robe.

While you wear the robe, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.

item.name: Robe of the Archmagi
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This elegant garment is made from exquisite cloth and adorned with runes.
You gain these benefits while wearing the robe.

entries.name: Armor
entries: If you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} is 15 plus your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: War Mage
entries: Your spell save DC and spell attack bonus each increase by 2.

item.name: Robe of Useful Items
entries: This robe has cloth patches of various shapes and colors covering it. While wearing the robe, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to detach one of the patches, causing it to become the object or creature it represents. Once the last patch is removed, the robe becomes an ordinary garment.
The robe has two of each of the following patches:
In addition, the robe has {@dice 4d4} other patches. The DM chooses the patches or determines them randomly by rolling on the following table.

rows: Silver coffer (1 foot long, 6 inches wide and deep) worth 500 GP
Iron door (up to 10 feet wide and 10 feet high, barred on one side of your choice), which you can place in an opening you can reach; it conforms to fit the opening, attaching and hinging itself
{@creature Riding Horse|SRD52} with a {@item Riding Saddle|SRD52}
Open pit (a 10-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube}), which you can place on the ground within 10 feet of yourself
{@item Spell Scroll|SRD52} containing one spell of level 1, 2, or 3 (your choice)
Window (2 feet by 4 feet, up to 2 feet deep), which you can place on a vertical surface you can reach

item.name: Rod of Absorption
entries: While holding this rod, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to absorb a spell that is targeting only you and doesn't create an area of effect. The absorbed spell's effect is canceled, and the spell's energy—not the spell itself—is stored in the rod. The energy has the same level as the spell when it was cast. A canceled spell dissipates with no effect, and any resources used to cast it are wasted. The rod can absorb and store up to 50 levels of energy over the course of its existence. Once the rod absorbs 50 levels of energy, it can't absorb more. If you are targeted by a spell that the rod can't store, the rod has no effect on that spell.
When you become attuned to the rod, you know how many levels of energy the rod has absorbed over the course of its existence and how many levels of spell energy it currently has stored.

If you are a spellcaster holding the rod, you can convert energy stored in it into spell slots to cast spells you have prepared or know. You can create spell slots only of a level equal to or lower than your own spell slots, up to a maximum of level 5. You use the stored levels in place of your slots but otherwise cast the spell as normal. For example, you can use 3 levels stored in the rod as a level 3 spell slot.
A newly found rod typically has {@dice 1d10} levels of spell energy stored in it. A rod that can no longer absorb spell energy and has no energy remaining becomes nonmagical.

item.name: Rod of Alertness
entries: This rod has the following properties.

entries.name: Alertness
entries: While holding the rod, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks and on {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the rod, you can cast the following spells from it:

entries.name: Protective Aura
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground, whereupon the rod's head sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 60-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 60 feet. While in that {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52}, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} and saving throws and can sense the location of any {@condition Invisible|SRD52} creature that is also in the {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52}.

The rod's head stops glowing and the effect ends after 10 minutes or when a creature takes a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to pull the rod from the ground. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Rod of Lordly Might
entries: This rod has a flanged head, and it functions as a magic Mace that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The rod has properties associated with six different buttons that are set in a row along the haft. It has three other properties as well, detailed below.

entries.name: Buttons
entries: You can press one of the following buttons as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}; a button's effect lasts until you push a different button or until you push the same button again, which causes the rod to revert to its normal form:

items.name: Button 1
entries: A fiery blade sprouts from the end opposite the rod's flanged head. The flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 40-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 40 feet, and the blade functions as a magic Longsword or Shortsword (your choice) that deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Fire damage on a hit.

items.name: Button 2
entries: The rod's flanged head folds down and two crescent-shaped blades spring out, transforming the rod into a magic Battleaxe that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

items.name: Button 3
entries: The rod's flanged head folds down, a spear point springs from the rod's tip, and the rod's handle lengthens into a 6-foot haft, transforming the rod into a magic Spear that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.

items.name: Button 4
entries: The rod transforms into a climbing pole up to 50 feet long (you specify the length), though the rod's buttons remain within your reach. In surfaces as hard as granite, a spike at the bottom and three hooks at the top anchor the pole. Horizontal bars 3 inches long fold out from the sides, 1 foot apart, forming a ladder. The pole can bear up to 4,000 pounds. More weight or lack of solid anchoring causes the rod to revert to its normal form.

items.name: Button 5
entries: The rod transforms into a handheld battering ram and grants its user a +10 bonus to Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) checks made to break through doors, barricades, and other barriers.

items.name: Button 6
entries: The rod assumes or remains in its normal form and indicates magnetic north. (Nothing happens if this function of the rod is used in a location that has no magnetic north.) The rod also gives you knowledge of your approximate depth beneath the ground or your height above it.

entries.name: Drain Life
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target takes an extra {@damage 4d6} Necrotic damage, and you regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to half that Necrotic damage. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Paralyze
entries: When you hit a creature with a melee attack using the rod, you can force the target to make a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Terrify
entries: While holding the rod, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to force each creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself to make a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. A {@condition Frightened|SRD52} target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Rod of Resurrection
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or paladin
entries: The rod has 5 charges. While you hold it, you can cast one of the following spells from it: {@spell Heal|SRD52} (expends 1 charge) or {@spell Resurrection|SRD52} (expends 5 charges).
The rod regains 1 expended charge daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the rod disappears in a harmless burst of radiance.

item.name: Rod of Rulership
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to present the rod and command obedience from each creature of your choice that you can see within 120 feet of yourself. Each target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition for 8 hours. While {@condition Charmed|SRD52} in this way, the creature regards you as its trusted leader. If harmed by you or your allies or commanded to do something contrary to its nature, a target ceases to be {@condition Charmed|SRD52} in this way. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Rod of Security
entries: While holding this rod, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to activate it. The rod then instantly transports you and up to 199 other willing creatures you can see to a demiplane. You choose the form the demiplane takes. It could be a tranquil garden, a cheery tavern, an immense palace, a tropical island, a fantastic carnival, or whatever else you can imagine. Regardless of its nature, the demiplane contains enough water and food to sustain its visitors, and the demiplane's environment can't harm its occupants. Everything else that can be interacted with there can exist only there. For example, a flower picked from a garden there disappears if it is taken outside the demiplane.

For each hour spent in the demiplane, a visitor regains {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} as if it had spent 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52|Hit Point Die}. Also, creatures don't age while there, although time passes normally. Visitors can remain there for up to 200 days divided by the number of creatures present (round down).

When the time runs out or you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to end the effect, all visitors reappear in the location they occupied when you activated the rod or an unoccupied space nearest that location. Once used, this property can't be used again until 10 days have passed.

item.name: Rope
entries: As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can tie a knot with Rope if you succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand|SRD52}) check. The Rope can be burst with a successful {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check.

You can bind an unwilling creature with the Rope only if the creature has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52}, {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52}, or {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition. If the creature's legs are bound, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until it escapes. Escaping the Rope requires the creature to make a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) check as an action.

item.name: Rope of Climbing
entries: This 60-foot length of rope can hold up to 3,000 pounds. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to command the other end of the rope to animate and move toward a destination you choose, up to the rope's length away from you. That end moves 10 feet on your turn when you first command it and 10 feet at the start of each of your subsequent turns until reaching its destination or until you tell it to stop. You can also tell the rope to fasten itself securely to an object or to unfasten itself, to knot or unknot itself, or to coil itself for carrying.

If you tell the rope to knot, large knots appear at 1-foot intervals along the rope. While knotted, the rope shortens to a 50-foot length and grants {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on ability checks made to climb using the rope.

The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}. If the rope drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it is destroyed.

item.name: Rope of Entanglement
entries: This rope is 30 feet long. While holding one end of the rope, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to command the other end to dart forward and entangle one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition. You can release the target by letting go of your end of the rope (causing the rope to coil up in the target's space) or by using a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to repeat the command (causing the rope to coil up in your hand).

A target {@condition Restrained|SRD52} by the rope can take an action to make its choice of a {@dc 15} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) or Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|SRD52}) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer {@condition Restrained|SRD52} by the rope. If you're still holding onto the rope when a target escapes from it, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to command the rope to coil up in your hand; otherwise, the rope coils up in the target's space.

The rope has AC 20, HP 20, and {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Poison and Psychic damage. It regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} every 5 minutes as long as it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}. If the rope drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it is destroyed.

item.name: Sack
entries: A Sack holds up to 30 pounds within 1 cubic foot.

item.name: Scarab of Protection
entries: This beetle-shaped medallion provides three benefits while it is on your person.

entries.name: Defense
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}.

entries.name: Preservation
entries: The scarab has 12 charges. If you fail a saving throw against a Necromancy spell or a harmful effect originating from an Undead, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to expend 1 charge and turn the failed save into a successful one. The scarab crumbles into powder and is destroyed when its last charge is expended.

entries.name: Spell Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells.

item.name: Scholar's Pack
entries: A Scholar's Pack contains the following items: {@item Backpack|SRD52}, {@item Book|SRD52}, {@item Ink|SRD52}, {@item Ink Pen|SRD52}, {@item Lamp|SRD52}, 10 flasks of {@item Oil|SRD52}, 10 sheets of {@item Parchment|SRD52}, and {@item Tinderbox|SRD52}.

item.name: Scimitar of Speed
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, you can make one attack with it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} on each of your turns.

item.name: Sending Stones
entries: Sending Stones come in pairs, with each stone carved to match the other so the pairing is easily recognized. While you touch one stone, you can cast {@spell Sending|SRD52} from it. The target is the bearer of the other stone. If no creature bears the other stone, you know that fact as soon as you use the stone, and you don't cast the spell.
Once Sending is cast using either stone, the stones can't be used again until the next dawn. If one of the stones in a pair is destroyed, the other one becomes nonmagical.

item.name: Sentinel Shield
entries: While holding this Shield, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) checks. The Shield is emblazoned with a symbol of an eye.

item.name: Serpent Venom
entries: A creature subjected to Serpent Venom must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw, taking 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

item.name: Shield of Missile Attraction
entries: While holding this Shield, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to damage from attacks made with Ranged weapons.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This Shield is cursed. Attuning to it curses you until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52} spell or similar magic. Removing the Shield fails to end the curse on you. Whenever an attack with a Ranged weapon targets a creature within 10 feet of you, the curse causes you to become the target instead.

item.name: Shield of the Cavalier
entries: While holding this Shield, you have a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}. This bonus is in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
The Shield has the following additional properties that you can use while holding it.

entries.name: Forceful Bash
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can make one of the attack rolls using the Shield against a target within 5 feet of yourself. Apply your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} and Strength modifier to the attack roll. On a hit, the Shield deals Force damage to the target equal to {@dice 2d6 + 2} plus your Strength modifier, and if the target is a creature, you can push it up to 10 feet directly away from yourself. If the creature is your size or smaller, you can also knock it down, giving it the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

entries.name: Protective Field
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52}, when you or an ally you can see within 5 feet of you is targeted by an attack or makes a saving throw against an area of effect, you can use the Shield to create an immobile 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you. When the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} appears, any creatures or objects not fully contained within it are pushed into the nearest unoccupied spaces outside it. The attack or area of effect that triggered the {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} has no effect on creatures and objects inside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation}, which lasts as long as you maintain {@status Concentration|SRD52}, up to 1 minute. Nothing can pass into or out of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation}. A creature or object inside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} can't be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} damage anything outside it. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Shovel
entries: Working for 1 hour, you can use a Shovel to dig a hole that is 5 feet on each side in soil or similar material.

item.name: Signal Whistle
entries: When blown as a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, a Signal Whistle produces a sound that can be heard up to 600 feet away.

item.name: Silver Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Slippers of Spider Climbing
entries: While you wear these light shoes, you can move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and along ceilings, while leaving your hands free. You have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. However, the slippers don't allow you to move this way on a slippery surface, such as one covered by ice or oil.

item.name: Sovereign Glue
entries: This viscous, milky-white substance can form a permanent adhesive bond between any two objects. It must be stored in a jar or flask that has been coated inside with {@item Oil of Slipperiness|SRD52}. When found, a container contains {@dice 1d6 + 1} ounces.

One ounce of the glue can cover a 1-foot square surface. Applying an ounce of Sovereign Glue takes a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, and the applied glue takes 1 minute to set. Once it has done so, the bond it creates can be broken only by the application of {@item Universal Solvent|SRD52} or {@item Oil of Etherealness|SRD52}, or with a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell.

item.name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
entries: A Spell Scroll bears the words of a single spell, written in a mystical cipher. If the spell is on your spell list, you can read the scroll and cast its spell without Material components. Otherwise, the scroll is unintelligible. Casting the spell by reading the scroll requires the spell's normal casting time. Once the spell is cast, the scroll crumbles to dust. If the casting is interrupted, the scroll isn't lost.

If the spell is on your spell list but of a higher level than you can normally cast, you make a {@dc 10} ability check using your spellcasting ability to determine whether you cast the spell. On a failed check, the spell disappears from the scroll with no other effect.
If the spell requires a saving throw or an attack roll, the spell save DC is 13, and the attack bonus is {@hit 5}.

entries.name: Copying a Scroll into a Spellbook
entries: A Wizard spell on a Spell Scroll can be copied into a spellbook. When a level 1 spell is copied in this way, the copier must succeed on a {@dc 11} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}). On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.

On a successful check, the spell is copied. Whether the check succeeds or fails, the Spell Scroll is destroyed.

item.name: Spellguard Shield
entries: While holding this Shield, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and spell attack rolls have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} against you.

item.name: Sphere of Annihilation
entries: This 2-foot-diameter black sphere is a hole in the multiverse, hovering in space and stabilized by a magical field surrounding it.

The sphere obliterates all matter it passes through and all matter that passes through it. Artifacts are the exception. Unless an Artifact is susceptible to damage from a Sphere of Annihilation, it passes through the sphere unscathed. Anything else that touches the sphere but isn't wholly engulfed and obliterated by it takes {@damage 8d10} Force damage.

entries.name: Controlling the Sphere
entries: A Sphere of Annihilation is stationary until someone takes control of it. If you are within 60 feet of a sphere, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to make a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}) check. On a successful check, you control the sphere until the start of your next turn, and if it was under another creature's control, that creature loses control of the sphere. On a failed check, the sphere moves 10 feet toward you in a straight line.

While in control of the sphere, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to cause it to move in one direction of your choice, up to a number of feet equal to 5 times your Intelligence modifier (minimum 5 feet). Any creature whose space the sphere enters must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or be touched by it, taking {@damage 8d10} Force damage. A creature reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this damage is obliterated, leaving its possessions behind but no other physical remains.

entries.name: Sphere Interactions
entries: If the sphere comes into contact with a planar portal (such as that created by the {@spell Gate|SRD52} spell) or an extradimensional space (such as that within a Portable Hole), the DM determines randomly what happens using the following table.

rows: The sphere moves through the portal or into the extradimensional space.
A spatial rift sends the sphere and each creature and object within 180 feet of the sphere to a random plane of existence.

item.name: Spyglass
entries: Objects viewed through a Spyglass are magnified to twice their size.

item.name: Staff of Charming
item.reqAttune: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can use any of its properties:

items.name: Cast Spell
entries: You can expend 1 of the staff's charges to cast {@spell Charm Person|SRD52}, {@spell Command|SRD52}, or {@spell Comprehend Languages|SRD52} from it using your spell save DC.

items.name: Reflect Enchantment
entries: If you succeed on a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to expend 1 charge from the staff and turn the spell back on its caster as if you had cast the spell.

items.name: Resist Enchantment
entries: If you fail a saving throw against an Enchantment spell that targets only you, you can turn your failed save into a successful one. You can't use this property of the staff again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d8 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff crumbles to dust and is destroyed.

item.name: Staff of Fire
item.reqAttune: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Fire damage while you hold this staff.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff crumbles into cinders and is destroyed.

item.name: Staff of Frost
item.reqAttune: by a druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Cold damage while you hold this staff.

entries.name: Spells
entries: The staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff turns to water and is destroyed.

item.name: Staff of Healing
item.reqAttune: by a bard, cleric, or druid
entries: This staff has 10 charges. While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spellcasting ability modifier. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

rows: 1 charge per spell level (maximum 4 for a level 4 spell)

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.

item.name: Staff of Power
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff has 20 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, saving throws, and spell attack rolls.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the staff , you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 2d8 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains {@dice 1d8 + 2} charges.

entries.name: Retributive Strike
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from itself. You have a {@chance 50} chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 4 times the number of charges in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

item.name: Staff of Striking
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it.
The staff has 10 charges. When you hit with a melee attack using it, you can expend up to 3 charges. For each charge you expend, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Force damage.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

item.name: Staff of Swarming Insects
item.reqAttune: by a bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff has 10 charges.

entries.name: Insect Cloud
entries: While holding the staff , you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and expend 1 charge to cause a swarm of harmless flying insects to fill a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you. The insects remain for 10 minutes, making the area {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52} for creatures other than you. A strong wind (like that created by {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52}) disperses the swarm and ends the effect.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC and spell attack modifier. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, a swarm of insects consumes and destroys the staff, then disperses.

item.name: Staff of the Magi
item.reqAttune: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
entries: This staff has 50 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While you hold it, you gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

entries.name: Spell Absorption
entries: While holding the staff , you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells. In addition, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} when another creature casts a spell that targets only you. If you do, the staff absorbs the magic of the spell, canceling its effect and gaining a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell's level. However, if doing so brings the staff's total number of charges above 50, the staff explodes as if you activated its Retributive Strike (see below).

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 4d6 + 2} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 20, the staff regains {@dice 1d12 + 1} charges.

entries.name: Retributive Strike
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to break the staff over your knee or against a solid surface. The staff is destroyed and releases its magic in an explosion that fills a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from itself. You have a {@chance 50} chance to instantly travel to a random plane of existence, avoiding the explosion. If you fail to avoid the effect, you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff. Each other creature in the area makes a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Force damage equal to 6 times the number of charges in the staff. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage.

item.name: Staff of the Python
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can throw this staff so that it lands in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you, causing the staff to become a {@creature Giant Constrictor Snake|SRD52} in that space. The snake is under your control and shares your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count, taking its turn immediately after yours.

On your turn, you can mentally command the snake (no action required) if it is within 60 feet of you and you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition. You decide what action the snake takes and where it moves during its turn, or you can issue it a general command, such as to attack your enemies or guard a location. Absent commands from you, the snake defends itself.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can command the snake to revert to staff form in its current space, and you can't use the staff's property again for 1 hour. If the snake is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it dies and reverts to its staff form; the staff then shatters and is destroyed. If the snake reverts to staff form before losing all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it regains all of them.

item.name: Staff of the Woodlands
item.reqAttune: by a druid
entries: This staff has 6 charges and can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the staff, you can cast one of the spells on the following table from it, using your spell save DC. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Tree Form
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to plant one end of the staff in earth in an unoccupied space and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree. The tree is 60 feet tall and has a 5-foot-diameter trunk, and its branches at the top spread out in a 20-foot radius. The tree appears ordinary but radiates a faint aura of Transmutation magic that can be discerned with the {@spell Detect Magic|SRD52} spell. While touching the tree and using a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you return the staff to its normal form. Any creature in the tree falls when the tree reverts to a staff.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The staff regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

item.name: Staff of Thunder and Lightning
entries: This staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff that grants a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. It also has the following additional properties. Once one of these properties is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Lightning
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the target to take an extra {@damage 2d6} Lightning damage (no action required).

entries.name: Thunder
entries: When you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can cause the staff to emit a crack of thunder audible out to 300 feet (no action required). The target you hit must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Thunder and Lightning
entries: Immediately after you hit with a melee attack using the staff, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to use the Lightning and Thunder properties (see above) at the same time. Doing so doesn't expend the daily use of those properties, only the use of this one.

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to cause a bolt of lightning to leap from the staff's tip in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} that is 5 feet wide and 120 feet long. Each creature in that {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} makes a {@dc 17} Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 9d6} Lightning damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Thunderclap
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to cause the staff to produce a thunderclap audible out to 600 feet. Every creature within a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you makes a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 2d6} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

item.name: Staff of Withering
item.reqAttune: by a cleric, druid, or warlock
entries: This staff has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

The staff can be wielded as a magic Quarterstaff. On a hit, it deals damage as a normal Quarterstaff , and you can expend 1 charge to deal an extra {@damage 2d10} Necrotic damage to the target and force it to make a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} for 1 hour on any ability check or saving throw that uses Strength or Constitution.

item.name: Stone of Controlling Earth Elementals
entries: While touching this 5-pound stone to the ground, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to summon an {@creature Earth Elemental|SRD52}. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space you choose within 30 feet of yourself, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count. The elemental disappears after 1 hour, when it dies, or when you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. The stone can't be used this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Stone of Good Luck
entries: While this polished agate is on your person, you gain a +1 bonus to ability checks and saving throws.

item.name: String
entries: String is 10 feet long. You can tie a knot in it as a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action.

item.name: Sun Blade
entries: This item appears to be a sword hilt.

entries.name: Blade of Radiance
entries: While grasping the hilt, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to cause a blade of pure radiance to spring into existence or make the blade disappear. While the blade exists, this magic weapon functions as a Longsword with {@itemProperty F|SRD52|Finesse}. If you are proficient with Longswords or Shortswords, you are proficient with the Sun Blade.

You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this weapon, which deals Radiant damage instead of Slashing damage. When you hit an Undead with it, that target takes an extra {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage.

entries.name: Sunlight
entries: The sword's luminous blade emits {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 15-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 15 feet. The light is sunlight. While the blade persists, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expand or reduce its radius of {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} by 5 feet each, to a maximum of 30 feet each or a minimum of 10 feet each.

item.name: Talisman of Pure Good
item.reqAttune: by a cleric or paladin
entries: This talisman is a mighty symbol of goodness. A Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes {@damage 8d6} Radiant damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

entries.name: Holy Symbol
entries: You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

entries.name: Pure Rebuke
entries: The talisman has 7 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Fiend or an Undead, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes {@damage 4d6} Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman disperses into motes of golden light and is destroyed.

item.name: Talisman of the Sphere
entries: While holding or wearing this talisman, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any Intelligence ({@skill Arcana|SRD52}) check you make to control a {@item Sphere of Annihilation|SRD52}. In addition, when you start your turn in control of a {@item Sphere of Annihilation|SRD52}, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to move it 10 feet plus a number of additional feet equal to 10 times your Intelligence modifier. This movement doesn't have to be in a straight line.

item.name: Talisman of Ultimate Evil
entries: This item symbolizes unrepentant evil. A creature that isn't a Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes {@damage 8d6} Necrotic damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman.

entries.name: Holy Symbol
entries: You can use the talisman as a Holy Symbol. You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it.

entries.name: Ultimate End
entries: The talisman has 6 charges. While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge and target one creature you can see on the ground within 120 feet of yourself. A flaming fissure opens under the target, and the target makes a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw. If the target is a Celestial, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the save. On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains. On a successful save, the target isn't cast into the fissure but takes {@damage 4d6} Psychic damage from the ordeal. In either case, the fissure then closes, leaving no trace of its existence. When you expend the last charge, the talisman dissolves into foul-smelling slime and is destroyed.

item.name: Tent
entries: A Tent sleeps up to two Small or Medium creatures.

items.name: Ability:
entries: Dexterity

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Pick a lock ({@dc 15}), or disarm a trap ({@dc 15})

items.name: Ability:
entries: Wisdom

items.name: Utilize:
entries: Discern whether someone is cheating ({@dc 10}), or win the game ({@dc 20})

item.name: Thunderous Greatclub
entries: While you are attuned to this magic weapon, your Strength is 20 unless your Strength is already equal to or greater than that score. The weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d8} Thunder damage to any creature it hits and an extra {@damage 3d8} Thunder damage to objects it hits that aren't being worn or carried.
The weapon has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Clap of Thunder
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can strike the weapon against a hard surface to create a loud clap of thunder audible out to 300 feet. You also create a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} of thunderous energy. Each creature in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. Nonmagical objects in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} that aren't being worn or carried take {@damage 3d8} Thunder damage.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can strike the weapon against the ground to create an intense seismic disturbance in a 50-foot-radius circle centered on the point of impact. Structures in contact with the ground in that area take 50 Bludgeoning damage, and each creature on the ground in that area must succeed on a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. If that creature is also {@status Concentration|SRD52|Concentrating}, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw or its {@status Concentration|SRD52} is broken. In addition, you can cause a 30-foot-deep, 10-foot-wide fissure to open up on the ground anywhere in the area. Any creature on a spot where the fissure opens must make a {@dc 20} Dexterity saving throw, falling into the fissure on a failed save or moving with the fissure's edge on a successful one. Any structure on a spot where the fissure opens collapses into the fissure. Once you use this property, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Tinderbox
entries: A Tinderbox is a small container holding flint, fire steel, and tinder (usually dry cloth soaked in light oil) used to kindle a fire. Using it to light a {@item Candle|SRD52}, {@item Lamp|SRD52}, {@item Hooded Lantern|SRD52|Lantern}, or {@item Torch|SRD52}—or anything else with exposed fuel—takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. Lighting any other fire takes 1 minute.

item.name: Tome of Clear Thought
entries: This book contains memory and logic exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Intelligence increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Tome of Leadership and Influence
entries: This book contains guidelines for influencing and charming others, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Charisma increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Tome of Understanding
entries: This book contains intuition and insight exercises, and its words are charged with magic. If you spend 48 hours over a period of 6 days or fewer studying the book's contents and practicing its guidelines, your Wisdom increases by 2, to a maximum of 30. The manual then loses its magic, but regains it in a century.

item.name: Torch
entries: A Torch burns for 1 hour, casting {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet. When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can attack with the Torch, using it as a Simple Melee weapon. On a hit, the target takes 1 Fire damage.

item.name: Torpor
entries: A creature subjected to Torpor poison must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for {@dice 4d6} hours. The creature's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is halved while the creature is {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} in this way.

item.name: Traveler's Clothes
entries: Traveler's Clothes are resilient garments designed for travel in various environments.

item.name: Trident of Fish Command
entries: This magic weapon has 3 charges, and it regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While you carry it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Dominate Beast|SRD52} (save {@dc 15}) from it on a Beast that has a {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52}.

item.name: Trinket
entries: When you make your character, you can roll once on the Trinkets table to gain a Tiny trinket, a simple item lightly touched by mystery. The DM might also use this table. It can help stock a room in a dungeon or fill a creature's pockets.

entries.caption: Trinkets
rows: A crystal that faintly glows in moonlight
A gold coin minted in an unknown land
A diary written in a language you don't know
A brass ring that never tarnishes
An old chess piece made from glass
A pair of knucklebone dice, each with a skull symbol on the side that would normally show six pips
A small idol depicting a nightmarish creature that gives you unsettling dreams when you sleep near it
The deed for a parcel of land in a realm unknown to you
A 1-ounce block made from an unknown material
A small cloth doll skewered with needles
A tooth from an unknown beast
An enormous scale, perhaps from a dragon
An old divination card bearing your likeness
A glass orb filled with moving smoke
A 1-pound egg with a bright-red shell
A glass jar containing a bit of flesh floating in pickling fluid
A gnome-crafted music box that plays a song you dimly remember from your childhood
A wooden statuette of a smug halfling
A brass orb etched with strange runes
A silver icon of a raven
A bag containing forty-seven teeth, one of which is rotten
A shard of obsidian that always feels warm to the touch
A dragon's talon strung on a leather necklace
A blank book whose pages refuse to hold ink, chalk, graphite, or any other marking
A silver badge that is a five-pointed star
A knife that belonged to a relative
A glass vial filled with nail clippings
A rectangular metal device with two tiny metal cups on one end that throws sparks when wet
A white, sequined glove sized for a human
A vest with one hundred tiny pockets
An empty glass vial that smells of perfume
A gemstone that looks like a lump of coal when examined by anyone but you
A scrap of cloth from an old banner
A rank insignia from a lost legionnaire
A silver bell without a clapper
A mechanical canary inside a lamp
A miniature chest carved to look like it has numerous feet on the bottom
A dead sprite inside a clear glass bottle
A metal can that has no opening but sounds as if it is filled with liquid, sand, spiders, or broken glass (your choice)
A glass orb filled with water, in which swims a clockwork goldfish
A silver spoon with an M engraved on the handle
A whistle made from gold-colored wood
A dead scarab beetle the size of your hand
Two toy soldiers, one missing a head
A small box filled with different-sized buttons
A candle that can't be lit
A miniature cage with no door
A hilt from a broken sword
A cameo of a hideous person
A silver skull the size of a coin
A cone of sticky black incense that stinks
A nightcap that gives you pleasant dreams when you wear it
A single caltrop made from bone
A gold monocle frame without the lens
A 1-inch cube, each side a different color
A packet filled with pink dust
A fragment of a beautiful song, written as musical notes on two pieces of parchment
A silver teardrop earring containing a real teardrop
An eggshell painted with scenes of misery in disturbing detail
A fan that, when unfolded, shows a sleepy cat
A four-leaf clover pressed inside a book discussing manners and etiquette
A sheet of parchment upon which is drawn a mechanical contraption
An ornate scabbard that fits no blade you have found
An invitation to a party where a murder happened
A bronze pentacle with an etching of a rat's head in its center
A purple handkerchief embroidered with the name of an archmage
Half a floor plan for a temple, a castle, or another structure
A bit of folded cloth that, when unfolded, turns into a stylish cap
A receipt of deposit at a bank in a far-off city
A diary with seven missing pages
An empty silver snuffbox bearing the inscription "dreams" on its lid
An iron holy symbol devoted to an unknown god
A book about a legendary hero's rise and fall, with the last chapter missing
An ancient arrow of elven design
An ornate brooch of dwarven design
An empty wine bottle bearing a pretty label that says, "The Wizard of Wines Winery, Red Dragon Crush, 331422-W"
A mosaic tile with a multicolored, glazed surface
A black pirate flag adorned with a dragon's skull and crossbones
A tiny mechanical crab or spider that moves about when it's not being observed
A glass jar containing lard with a label that reads, "Griffon Grease"
A wooden box with a ceramic bottom that holds a living worm with a head on each end of its body
A metal urn containing the ashes of a hero

item.name: Truth Serum
entries: A creature subjected to Truth Serum must succeed on a {@dc 11} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition for 1 hour. The {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} creature can't knowingly communicate a lie.

item.name: Universal Solvent
entries: This tube holds milky liquid with a strong alcohol smell. When found, a tube contains {@dice 1d6 + 1} ounces.

You can take a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action to pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach. Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

item.name: Vial
entries: A Vial holds up to 4 ounces.

item.name: Wand of Binding
entries: This wand has 7 charges.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save {@dc 17}) on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Enemy Detection
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge. For 1 minute, you know the direction of the nearest creature {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} to you within 60 feet, but not its distance from you. The wand can sense the presence of {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|SRD52|Hostile} creatures that are {@condition Invisible|SRD52}, ethereal, disguised, or hidden, as well as those in plain sight. The effect ends if you stop holding the wand.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Fear
entries: This wand has 7 charges.

entries.name: Spells
entries: While holding the wand, you can cast one of the spells (save {@dc 15}) on the following table from it. The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Fireballs
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast {@spell Fireball|SRD52} (save {@dc 15}) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 3 version of the spell. You can increase the spell's level by 1 for each additional charge you expend.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Lightning Bolts
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast {@spell Lightning Bolt|SRD52} (save {@dc 15}) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 3 version of the spell. You can increase the spell's level by 1 for each additional charge you expend.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Magic Detection
entries: This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Detect Magic|SRD52} from it. The wand regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Wand of Magic Missiles
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend no more than 3 charges to cast {@spell Magic Missile|SRD52} from it. For 1 charge, you cast the level 1 version of the spell. You can increase the spell's level by 1 for each additional charge you expend.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Paralysis
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge to cause a thin blue ray to streak from the tip toward a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the target's turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Polymorph
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Polymorph|SRD52} (save {@dc 15}) from it.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Secrets
entries: This wand has 3 charges and regains {@dice 1d3} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge, and if a secret door or trap is within 60 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.

item.name: Wand of Web
item.reqAttune: by a spellcaster
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Web|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}) from it.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

item.name: Wand of Wonder
entries: This wand has 7 charges. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge while choosing a point within 120 feet of yourself. That location becomes the point of origin of a spell or other magical effect determined by rolling on the Wand of Wonder Effects table. Spells cast from the wand have a save DC of 15. If a spell's maximum range is normally less than 120 feet, it becomes 120 feet when cast from the wand. If an effect has multiple possible subjects, the DM determines randomly which among them are affected.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
entries: The wand regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 1, the wand crumbles into dust and is destroyed.

entries.caption: Wand of Wonder Effects
rows: You cast a spell originating from the chosen point. Roll {@dice 1d10} to determine the spell: on a {@b 1-2}, {@spell Darkness|SRD52}; on a {@b 3-4}, {@spell Faerie Fire|SRD52}; on a {@b 5-6}, {@spell Fireball|SRD52}; on a {@b 7-8}, {@spell Slow|SRD52}; on a {@b 9-10}, {@spell Stinking Cloud|SRD52}.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you have the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the start of your next turn, believing something awesome just happened.
You cast {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52}. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you take {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage.

Heavy rain falls for 1 minute in a 120-foot-high, 60-foot-radius {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} centered on the chosen point of origin. During that time, the area of effect is {@variantrule Lightly Obscured|SRD52}.

A cloud of 600 oversized butterflies fills a 60-foot-high, 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} centered on the chosen point of origin. The butterflies remain for 10 minutes, during which time the area of effect is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52}.
You cast {@spell Lightning Bolt|SRD52}. The {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} created by the spell extends from you to the chosen point of origin.

The creature closest to the chosen point of origin is enlarged as if you had cast {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} on it. If the target isn't you and can't be affected by that spell, you become the target instead.

A magically formed creature appears in an unoccupied space as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. The creature isn't under your control, acts as it normally would, and disappears after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine which creature appears. On a {@b 1}, a {@creature Rhinoceros|SRD52} appears; on a {@b 2}, an {@creature Elephant|SRD52} appears; and on a {@b 3-4}, a {@creature Rat|SRD52} appears.

Grass covers a 60-foot-radius circle of ground, with the center of that circle as close to the chosen point of origin as possible. Grass that's already there grows to ten times its normal size and remains overgrown for 1 minute.

An object of the DM's choice disappears into the Ethereal Plane. The object must be neither worn nor carried, within 120 feet of the chosen point of origin, and no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. If there are no such objects in range, nothing happens.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you shrink as if you had cast {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|SRD52} on yourself and remain in that state for 1 minute.
Leaves grow from the creature nearest to the chosen point of origin. Unless they are picked off, the leaves turn brown and fall off after 24 hours.

Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a burst of colorful, shimmering light extends from you in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation}. Each creature in the area must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. A creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, you cast {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} on yourself.

Nothing happens at the chosen point of origin. Instead, a stream of {@dice 1d4 × 10} gems, each worth 1 GP, shoots from the wand's tip in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} 30 feet long and 5 feet wide toward the chosen point of origin. Each gem deals 1 Bludgeoning damage, and the total damage of the gems is divided equally among all creatures in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line}.

You cast {@spell Polymorph|SRD52}, targeting the creature closest to the chosen point of origin. Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the target's new form. On a {@b 1}, the new form is a {@creature Black Bear|SRD52}; on a {@b 2}, the new form is a {@creature Giant Wasp|SRD52}; on a {@b 3-4}, the new form is a {@creature Frog|SRD52}.

The creature closest to the chosen point of origin makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and begins to turn to stone. While {@condition Restrained|SRD52} in this way, the creature repeats the save at the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the effect ends. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Petrified|SRD52} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the {@spell Greater Restoration|SRD52} spell or similar magic.

item.name: Waterskin
entries: A Waterskin holds up to 4 pints. If you don't drink sufficient water, you risk dehydration.

item.name: Well of Many Worlds
entries: This fine black cloth, soft as silk, is folded up to the dimensions of a handkerchief. It unfolds into a circular sheet 6 feet in diameter.

You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to unfold the Well of Many Worlds and place it on a solid surface, whereupon it forms a two-way, 6-foot-diameter, circular portal to another world or plane of existence. Each time the item opens a portal, the DM decides where it leads. The portal remains open until a creature within 5 feet of it takes a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to close it by taking hold of the edges of the cloth and folding it up.
Once the Well of Many Worlds has opened a portal, it can't do so again for {@dice 1d8} hours.

item.name: White Dragon Scale Mail
entries: {#itemEntry Dragon Scale Mail|SRD52}

item.name: Wind Fan
entries: While holding this fan, you can cast {@spell Gust of Wind|SRD52} (save {@dc 13}) from it. Each subsequent time the fan is used before the next dawn, it has a cumulative {@chance 20} chance of not working; if the fan fails to work, it tears into useless, nonmagical tatters.

item.name: Winged Boots
entries: These boots have 4 charges and regain {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing the boots, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to expend 1 charge, gaining a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 30 feet for 1 hour. If you are flying when the duration expires, you descend at a rate of 30 feet per round until you land.

item.name: Wings of Flying
entries: While wearing this cloak, you can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to turn the cloak into a pair of wings on your back. The wings lasts for 1 hour or until you end the effect early as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action. The wings give you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} of 60 feet. If you are aloft when the wings disappear, you fall. When the wings disappear, you can't use them again for {@dice 1d12} hours.

item.name: Wyvern Poison
entries: A creature subjected to Wyvern Poison makes a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw, taking 24 ({@damage 7d6}) Poison damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

itemEntry.name: Armor of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while you wear this armor.

itemEntry.name: Dragon Scale Mail
entriesTemplate: Dragon Scale Mail is made of the scales of one kind of dragon. Sometimes dragons collect their cast-off scales and gift them. Other times, hunters carefully preserve the hide of a dead dragon. In either case, Dragon Scale Mail is highly valued.

While wearing this armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against the breath weapons of Dragons, and you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage.

Additionally, you can focus your senses as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to discern the distance and direction to the closest {{item.detail1}} dragon within 30 miles of yourself. This action can't be used again until the next dawn.

itemEntry.name: Grenade
entriesTemplate: As an action, you can either throw a grenade at a point up to 60 feet away or use a Grenade Launcher to propel the grenade to a point up to 1,000 feet away. The grenade explodes at that point, creating a particular effect in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Sphere}.

itemEntry.name: Ioun Stone
entriesTemplate: Roughly marble sized, {@i Ioun Stones} are named after Ioun, a god of knowledge and prophecy revered on some worlds. Many types of {@i Ioun Stones} exist, each type a distinct combination of shape and color.

When you take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to toss an {@i Ioun Stone} into the air, the stone orbits your head at a distance of {@dice 1d3} feet, conferring its benefit to you while doing so. You can have up to three {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head at the same time.

Each {@i Ioun Stone} orbiting your head is considered to be an object you are wearing. The orbiting stone avoids contact with other creatures and objects, adjusting its orbit to avoid collisions and thwarting all attempts by other creatures to attack or snatch it.

As a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action, you can seize and stow any number of {@i Ioun Stones} orbiting your head. If your {@variantrule Attunement|SRD52} to an Ioun Stone ends while it's orbiting your head, the stone falls as though you had dropped it.

itemEntry.name: Potion of Resistance
entriesTemplate: When you drink this potion, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage for 1 hour.

itemEntry.name: Ring of Resistance
entriesTemplate: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to {{getFullImmRes item.resist}} damage while wearing this ring. The ring is set with {{item.detail1}}.

itemEntry.name: Scroll of Protection
entriesTemplate: Using a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to read the scroll creates a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you. For 5 minutes, {{item.detail2}} can't enter or affect anything in the area. However, if you move in such a way that an {{item.detail1}} would be inside the area, the effect ends.

As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, a creature within 5 feet of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} can attempt to overcome it, which forces the creature to make a {@dc 15} Charisma saving throw. On a successful save, the creature ceases to be affected by the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation}.

itemGroup.name: Armor of Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to one type of damage while you wear this armor. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

rows: {@item Belt of Frost Giant Strength|SRD52} or {@item Belt of Stone Giant Strength|SRD52}

itemGroup.name: Carpet of Flying
entries: You can make this carpet hover and fly by taking a {@action Magic|SRD52} action and using the carpet's command word. It moves according to your directions if you are within 30 feet of it.
