Four sizes of Carpet of Flying exist. The DM chooses the size of a given carpet or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. A carpet can carry up to twice the weight shown on the table, but its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is halved if it carries more than its normal capacity.

itemGroup.name: Figurine of Wondrous Power
items: Figurine of Wondrous Power, Bronze Griffon|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Ebony Fly|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Golden Lions|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Ivory Goats|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Marble Elephant|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Obsidian Steed|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Onyx Dog|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Serpentine Owl|SRD52
Figurine of Wondrous Power, Silver Raven|SRD52

itemGroup.name: Horn of Valhalla
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|SRD52} action to blow this horn. In response, warrior spirits from the plane of Ysgard appear in unoccupied spaces within 60 feet of you. Each spirit uses the {@creature Berserker|SRD52} stat block and returns to Ysgard after 1 hour or when it drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The spirits look like living, breathing warriors, and they have {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions. Once you use the horn, it can't be used again until 7 days have passed.

Four types of Horn of Valhalla are known to exist, each made of a different metal. The horn's type determines how many spirits it summons, as well as the requirement for its use. The DM chooses the horn's type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table. If you blow the horn without meeting its requirement, the summoned spirits attack you.
If you meet the requirement, they are {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you and your allies and follow your commands.

itemGroup.name: Ioun Stone
entries: {#itemEntry Ioun Stone|SRD52}
The type of stone determines its rarity and effects.

itemGroup.name: Manual of Golems
entries: This tome contains information and incantations necessary to make a particular type of golem. To decipher and use the manual, you must be a spellcaster with at least two 5th-level spell slots. A creature that can't use a manual of golems and attempts to read it takes {@damage 6d6} psychic damage.

To create a golem, you must spend the time shown on the table, working without interruption with the manual at hand and resting no more than 8 hours per day. You must also pay the specified cost to purchase supplies.

Once you finish creating the golem, the book is consumed in eldritch flames. The golem becomes animate when the ashes of the manual are sprinkled on it. It is under your control, and it understands and obeys your spoken commands.

itemGroup.name: Potion of Resistance
entries: When you drink this potion, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to one type of damage for 1 hour. The DM chooses the type or determines it randomly by rolling on the following table.

itemGroup.name: Feather Token
entries: This object looks like a feather. Different types of feather tokens exist, each with a different single-use effect. The DM chooses the kind of token or determines it randomly by rolling on the Feather Tokens table. The type of token determines its rarity.

itemGroup.name: Ring of Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to one damage type while wearing this ring. The gemstone in the ring indicates the type, which the DM chooses or determines randomly by rolling on the following table.

itemMastery.name: Cleave
entries: If you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can make a melee attack roll with the weapon against a second creature within 5 feet of the first that is also within your reach. On a hit, the second creature takes the weapon's damage, but don't add your ability modifier to that damage unless that modifier is negative. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

itemMastery.name: Graze
entries: If your attack roll with this weapon misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon, and the damage can be increased only by increasing the ability modifier.

itemMastery.name: Nick
entries: When you make the extra attack of the Light property, you can make it as part of the {@action Attack|SRD52} action instead of as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. You can make this extra attack only once per turn.

itemMastery.name: Push
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from yourself if it is Large or smaller.

itemMastery.name: Sap
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn.

itemMastery.name: Slow
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

itemMastery.name: Topple
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 8} plus the ability modifier used to make the attack roll and your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

itemMastery.name: Vex
entries: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to the creature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on your next attack roll against that creature before the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Treasure (Art Object)
entries: Idols cast of solid gold, necklaces studded with precious stones, paintings of ancient kings, bejeweled dishes—art objects include all these and more.

entries.name: Treasure (Coinage)
entries: Characters often find coins on their adventures and can spend those coins in shops, inns, and other businesses. Coins come in different denominations based on the relative worth of their material. The Coin Values table lists coins and how much they're worth relative to the Gold Piece, which is the game's main coin. For example, 100 Copper Pieces are worth 1 Gold Piece.
A coin weighs about a third of an ounce, so fifty coins weigh a pound.

entries.name: Treasure (Gemstone)
entries: Gemstones are small, lightweight, and easily secured compared to their same value in coins.

entries.name: Artisan's Tool
entries: Artisan's Tools are each focused on crafting items and pursuing a trade. Each type of Artisan's Tools tools requires a separate proficiency.

If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check too.

entries.name: Tool (Gaming Set)
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check too.

entries.name: Tool (Musical Instrument)
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check too.

entries.name: Range
entries: A Range weapon has a range in parentheses after the Ammunition or Thrown property. The range lists two numbers. The first is the weapon's normal range in feet, and the second is the weapon's long range. When attacking a target beyond normal range, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the attack roll. You can't attack a target beyond the long range.

entries.name: Speed
entries: A ship sailing against a strong wind moves at half speed. In a dead calm (no wind), waterborne ships can't move under sail and must be rowed. Keelboats and Rowboats are used on lakes and rivers. If going downstream, add the speed of the current (typically 3 miles per hour) to the speed of the vehicle. These vehicles can't be rowed against any significant current, but they can be pulled upstream by draft animals on the shores. A Rowboat can be carried and weighs 100 pounds.

entries.name: Crew
entries: A ship larger than a Keelboat or Rowboat needs a crew of skilled hirelings (see "{@book Services|SRD52|6|Services}") to function. The minimum number of skilled hirelings needed to crew a ship depends on the type of ship.

entries.name: Passengers
entries: The number of Small and Medium passengers the ship can accommodate using hammocks. A ship outfitted with private accommodations can carry one-fifth as many passengers. A passenger usually pays 5 SP per day for a hammock, but prices can vary from ship to ship. A small private cabin usually costs 2 GP per day.

entries.name: Damage Threshold
entries: See the {@variantrule Damage Threshold|SRD52|rules glossary}.

entries.name: Ship Repair
entries: Repairs to a damaged ship can be made while the vessel is berthed. Repairing 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} of damage requires 1 day and costs 20 GP for materials and labor. If the repairs are made in a location where supplies and skilled labor are abundant, such as a city shipyard, the repair time and cost are halved.

entries.name: Tool
entries: If you have proficiency with a tool, add your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus} to any ability check you make that uses the tool. If you have proficiency in a skill that's used with that check, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the check too.

entries.name: Trade Bar
entries: Because large numbers of coins can be difficult to transport and account for, many merchants prefer to use trade bars—ingots of precious metals and alloys (usually silver). These bars are valued by weight.

entries.name: Trade Good
entries: Merchants commonly exchange trade goods without using currency.

magicvariant.name: +1 Ammunition
entries: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

This ammunition is typically found or sold in quantities of ten or twenty pieces. Ten pieces of this ammunition are equivalent in value to a potion of the same rarity {@note ({@table Magic Item Values by Rarity; Magic Item Rarities and Values|SRD52|200 GP})}.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
You have a {=bonusAc} bonus to AC while wearing this armor.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

magicvariant.name: +1 Shield
entries: {@note * This generic variant has the same name and source as the item {@item +1 Shield|SRD52}}.
While holding this Shield, you have a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
While holding this Shield, you have a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

magicvariant.name: +2 Ammunition
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

This ammunition is typically found or sold in quantities of ten or twenty pieces. Ten pieces of this ammunition are equivalent in value to a potion of the same rarity {@note ({@table Magic Item Values by Rarity; Magic Item Rarities and Values|SRD52|2,000 GP})}.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
You have a {=bonusAc} bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

magicvariant.name: +2 Shield
entries: {@note * This generic variant has the same name and source as the item {@item +2 Shield|SRD52}}.
While holding this Shield, you have a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
While holding this Shield, you have a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

magicvariant.name: +3 Ammunition
entries: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.

This ammunition is typically found or sold in quantities of ten or twenty pieces. Ten pieces of this ammunition are equivalent in value to a potion of the same rarity {@note ({@table Magic Item Values by Rarity; Magic Item Rarities and Values|SRD52|20,000 GP})}.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this piece of magic ammunition. Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
You have a {=bonusAc} bonus to AC while wearing this armor.

magicvariant.name: +3 Shield
entries: {@note * This generic variant has the same name and source as the item {@item +3 Shield|SRD52}}.
While holding this Shield, you have a +3 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
While holding this Shield, you have a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, in addition to the Shield's normal bonus to AC.
You have a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
This suit of armor is reinforced with adamantine, one of the hardest substances in existence. While you're wearing it, any {@variantrule Critical Hit|SRD52} against you becomes a normal hit.

This magic ammunition is meant to slay creatures of a particular type, which the DM chooses or determines randomly by rolling on the table below. If a creature of that type takes damage from the ammunition, the creature makes a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw, taking an extra {@damage 6d10} Force damage on a failed save or half as much extra damage on a successful one.
After dealing its extra damage to a creature, the ammunition becomes nonmagical.
While wearing this armor, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the {@spell Identify|SRD52} spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52} spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|SRD52} to Piercing and Slashing damage.
While wearing this armor, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Piercing damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the {@spell Identify|SRD52} spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52} spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|SRD52} to Bludgeoning and Slashing damage.
While wearing this armor, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Slashing damage.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This armor is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the {@spell Identify|SRD52} spell is cast on the armor or you attune to it. Attuning to the armor curses you until you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52} spell or similar magic; removing the armor fails to end the curse. While cursed, you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|SRD52} to Bludgeoning and Piercing damage.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon, your {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained.

entries.name: Curse
entries: This weapon is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the weapon, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls with weapons other than this one.

Whenever another creature damages you while the weapon is in your possession, you must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom saving throw or go berserk. This berserk state ends when you start your turn and there are no creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear.

While berserk, you regard the creature nearest to you that you can see or hear as your enemy. If there are multiple possible creatures, choose one at random. On each of your turns, you must move as close to the creature as possible and take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, targeting the creature. If you're unable to get close enough to the creature to attack it with the weapon, your turn ends after you've used up all your available movement. If the creature dies or can no longer be seen or heard by you, the next nearest creature that you can see or hear becomes your new target.

You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to toss this magic weapon into the air. When you do so, the weapon begins to hover, flies up to 30 feet, and attacks one creature of your choice within 5 feet of itself. The weapon uses your attack roll and adds your ability modifier to damage rolls.

While the weapon hovers, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to cause it to fly up to 30 feet to another spot within 30 feet of you. As part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can cause the weapon to attack one creature within 5 feet of the weapon.

After the hovering weapon attacks for the fourth time, it flies back to you and tries to return to your hand. If you have no hand free, the weapon falls to the ground in your space. If the weapon has no unobstructed path to you, it moves as close to you as it can and then falls to the ground. It also ceases to hover if you grasp it or are more than 30 feet away from it.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

The first time you attack with the weapon on each of your turns, you can transfer some or all of the weapon's bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}. For example, you could reduce the bonus to your attack rolls and damage rolls to {=bonusAc} and gain a +2 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}. The adjusted bonuses remain in effect until the start of your next turn, although you must hold the weapon to gain a bonus to AC from it.

While wearing this armor, you gain a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}, and you know Abyssal. In addition, the armor's clawed gauntlets allow your Unarmed Strikes to deal {@damage 1d8} Slashing damage instead of the usual Bludgeoning damage, and you gain a {=bonusWeapon} bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your Unarmed Strikes.

entries.name: Curse
entries: Once you don this cursed armor, you can't doff it unless you are targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52} spell or similar magic. While wearing the armor, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls against demons and on saving throws against their spells and special abilities.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.
The weapon deals an extra {@damage 3d6} damage of the weapon's type if the target is a Dragon.

While wearing this armor, you gain a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52}. In addition, if an effect moves you against your will along the ground, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to reduce the distance you are moved by up to 10 feet.
You gain a {=bonusAc} bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|SRD52} while you wear this armor. You are considered trained with this armor even if you lack training with Medium or Heavy armor.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which has no string. Each time you pull your arm back in a firing motion, a magical arrow made of golden energy appears nocked and ready to fire. An arrow produced by this weapon deals Force damage instead of Piercing damage on a hit, and it disappears after it hits or misses its target. Until it disappears, the arrow emits {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 20 feet.
This weapon has the following additional properties.

entries.name: Arrow of Restraint
entries: Whenever you use this weapon to make a ranged attack against a creature, you can try to restrain the target instead of dealing damage to it. If the arrow hits, the target must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. As an action, a creature {@condition Restrained|SRD52} by an arrow can make a {@dc 20} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check to try to break the restraint, ending the effect on itself on a successful check.

entries.name: Arrow of Transport
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can fire one energy arrow from this weapon at a target you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The target can be either a willing Medium or smaller creature or an object that isn't being worn or carried, provided the object is small enough to fit inside a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube}. The arrow teleports the target to an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of you.

entries.name: Energy Ladder
entries: As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can loose a flurry of energy arrows from this weapon at a wall up to 60 feet away from yourself. The arrows become glowing rungs that stick out of the wall, forming a magical ladder up to 60 feet long on the wall. This ladder lasts for 1 minute before disappearing.

While holding this magic weapon, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} and use a command word to cause flames to engulf the damage-dealing part of the weapon. These flames shed {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 40-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 40 feet. While the weapon is ablaze, it deals an extra {@damage 2d6} Fire damage on a hit. The flames last until you take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to issue the command again or until you drop, stow, or sheathe the weapon.

When you hit with an attack roll using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} Cold damage. In addition, while you hold the weapon, you have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Fire damage.
In freezing temperatures, the weapon sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 10 feet.
When you draw this weapon, you can extinguish all nonmagical flames within 30 feet of yourself. Once used, this property can't be used again for 1 hour.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

When you hit a Giant with this weapon, the Giant takes an extra {@damage 2d6} damage of the weapon's type and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Strength saving throw or have the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

The weapon has 5 charges. You can expend 1 charge and make a ranged attack with the weapon, hurling it as if it had {@itemProperty T|SRD52|Thrown} with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet.

If the attack hits, the weapon unleashes a thunderclap audible out to 300 feet. The target and every creature within 30 feet of it other than you must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the end of your next turn. Immediately after hitting or missing, the weapon flies back to your hand. The weapon regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn.

entries.name: Giant's Bane
entries: While you are attuned to the weapon and wearing either a {@item Belt of Giant Strength|SRD52} or {@item Gauntlets of Ogre Power|SRD52} to which you are also attuned, you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Giants' Bane
entries: When you roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll made with this weapon against a Giant, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or die.

items.name: Might of Giants
entries: The Strength score bestowed by your {@item Belt of Giant Strength|SRD52} or {@item Gauntlets of Ogre Power|SRD52} increases by 4, to a maximum of 30.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a Fiend or an Undead with it, that creature takes an extra {@damage 2d10} Radiant damage.

While you hold the drawn weapon, it creates a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from you. You and all creatures {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|SRD52|Friendly} to you in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects. If you have 17 or more levels in the Paladin class, the size of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} increases to 30 feet.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While the weapon is on your person, you also gain a {=bonusSavingThrow} bonus to saving throws.

entries.name: Luck
entries: If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed {@variantrule D20 Test|SRD52} if you don't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition. You must use the second roll. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Wish
entries: The weapon has {@dice 1d3} charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge and cast {@spell Wish|SRD52} from it. Once used, this property can't be used again until the next dawn. The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.
Mithral is a light, flexible metal. A mithral chain shirt or breastplate can be worn under normal clothes.
If the armor normally imposes disadvantage on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|SRD52}) checks or has a Strength requirement, the mithral version of the armor doesn't.
You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Life Stealing
entries: The weapon has {@dice 1d8 + 1} charges. When you attack a creature that has fewer than 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} with this weapon and roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the attack roll, the creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be slain instantly as the sword tears its life force from its body. Constructs and Undead succeed on the save automatically. The weapon loses 1 charge if the creature is slain. When the weapon has no charges remaining, it loses this property.

When you nock an arrow on this bow, it whispers in Elvish, "Swift defeat to my enemies." When you use this weapon to make a ranged attack, you can utter or sign the following command words: "Swift death to you who have wronged me." The target of your attack becomes your sworn enemy until it dies or until dawn 7 days later. You can have only one such sworn enemy at a time. When your sworn enemy dies, you can choose a new one after the next dawn.

When you make a ranged attack roll with this weapon against your sworn enemy, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the roll. In addition, your target gains no benefit from {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Half Cover} or {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Three-Quarters Cover}, and you suffer no {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} due to long range. If the attack hits, your sworn enemy takes an extra {@damage 3d6} Piercing damage.
While your sworn enemy lives, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls with all other weapons.

When you attack a creature with this magic weapon and roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 15 Necrotic damage if it isn't a Construct or an Undead, and you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the amount of Necrotic damage taken.
When you attack an object with this magic weapon and hit, maximize your weapon damage dice against the target.
When you attack a creature with this weapon and roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the attack roll, that target takes an extra 14 Slashing damage and gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level.

When you hit a creature with an attack using this magic weapon, the target takes an extra {@damage 2d6} Necrotic damage and must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or be unable to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} for 1 hour. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
This magic weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d6} damage to any creature it hits. This extra damage is of the same type as the weapon's normal damage.
You gain a +3 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, the weapon ignores {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Slashing damage.

When you use this weapon to attack a creature that has at least one head and roll a 20 on the {@dice d20} for the attack roll, you cut off one of the creature's heads. The creature dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature is immune to this effect if it has {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Slashing damage, if it doesn't have or need a head, or if the DM decides that the creature is too big for its head to be cut off with this weapon. Such a creature instead takes an extra 30 Slashing damage from the hit. If the creature has Legendary {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52}, it can expend one daily use of that trait to avoid losing its head, taking the extra damage instead.
As long as this weapon is within your reach and you are attuned to it, you and allies within 30 feet of you gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Alarm
entries: The weapon magically awakens each subject who is sleeping naturally when combat begins. This benefit doesn't wake a subject from magically induced sleep.

entries.name: Supernatural Readiness
entries: Each subject has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on its {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} rolls.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Eldritch Restoration
entries: If destroyed, the aboleth gains a new body in {@dice 5d10} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} in the Far Realm or another location chosen by the DM.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the aboleth fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Mucus Cloud
entries: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by mucus. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the aboleth at the end of the aboleth's turn. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. Until the curse ends, the target's skin becomes slimy, the target can breathe air and water, and it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} unless it is underwater.

While the cursed creature is outside a body of water, the creature takes 6 ({@damage 1d12}) Acid damage at the end of every 10 minutes unless moisture is applied to its skin before those minutes have passed.

trait.name: Probing Telepathy

action.name: Dominate Mind (2/Day)

headerEntries: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Spiritual Weapon (2/Day)
headerEntries: The cultist casts the {@spell Spiritual Weapon|SRD52} spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Pact Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Crush
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way.

While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on its attack rolls. Its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it moves with the target.

A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful {@dc 13} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.

action.name: Darkness Aura (1/Day)
entries: Magical {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52} fills a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains {@status Concentration|SRD52} on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 12}. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition. While {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}).

trait.name: Agile
entries: The deer doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52} when it moves out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):
will: {@spell Shapechange|SRD52} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} gained from the spell, and no {@status Concentration|SRD52} or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} required to maintain the spell)

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid (2/Day)
headerEntries: The deva casts {@spell Cure Wounds|SRD52}, {@spell Lesser Restoration|SRD52}, or {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Exalted Restoration
entries: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in Mount Celestia.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The deva has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.

action.name: Holy Mace
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Radiant damage.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The wolf has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

2e: {@spell Create Food and Water|SRD52} (can create wine instead of water)

trait.name: Elemental Restoration
entries: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere on the Plane of Air.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The djinni has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Wishes
entries: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Storm Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 feet. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Storm Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 feet. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Create Whirlwind
entries: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni's {@status Concentration|SRD52} on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns.

Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature's space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 17} (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). {@actSaveFail} While in the whirlwind, the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} target takes 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

spellcasting.name: Read Thoughts
headerEntries: The doppelganger casts {@spell Detect Thoughts|SRD52}, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 12}).

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6} (with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Unsettling Visage {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The dragon can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 15 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to this Fire damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 13}, reach 15 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to this Fire damage.

monster.name: Dretch
languages: Abyssal; telepathy 60 ft. (works only with creatures that understand Abyssal)

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Fetid Cloud (1/Day)
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the dretch. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition until the end of its next turn. While {@condition Poisoned|SRD52}, the creature can take either an action or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} on its turn, not both, and it can't take Reactions.

spellcasting.name: Magic of the Spider Queen {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The drider casts {@spell Darkness|SRD52}, {@spell Faerie Fire|SRD52}, or {@spell Web|SRD52}, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}).

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The drider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the drider has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ability checks and attack rolls.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The drider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the drider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The drider makes three attacks, using Foreleg or Poison Burst in any combination.

action.name: Foreleg
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Poison Burst
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 120 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The druid casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The druid makes two attacks, using Vine Staff or Verdant Wisp in any combination.

action.name: Vine Staff
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

action.name: Verdant Wisp
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 90 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) Radiant damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dryad casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):
will: {@spell Charm Monster|SRD52} (lasts 24 hours; ends early if the dryad casts the spell again)

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The dryad has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
entries: The dryad can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dryad makes one Vine Lash or Thorn Burst attack, and it can use Spellcasting to cast {@spell Charm Monster|SRD52}.

action.name: Vine Lash
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Thorn Burst
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Tree Stride
entries: If within 5 feet of a Large or bigger tree, the dryad teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a second Large or bigger tree that is within 60 feet of the previous tree.

spellcasting.name: Sleep (1/Day)
headerEntries: The mephit casts the {@spell Sleep|SRD52} spell, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 10}).

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Blinding Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition until the end of the mephit's next turn.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 feet. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Earth Glide
entries: The elemental can burrow through nonmagical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the elemental doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The elemental deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two attacks, using Slam or Rock Launch in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 10 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rock Launch
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d6 + 5}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The efreeti casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Elemental Restoration
entries: If the efreeti dies outside the Elemental Plane of Fire, its body dissolves into ash, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d4} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere on the Plane of Fire.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The efreeti has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Wishes
entries: The efreeti has a 30 percent chance of knowing the {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell. If the efreeti knows it, the efreeti can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the efreeti can understand. If the efreeti casts the spell for the creature, the efreeti suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the efreeti has cast it three times, the efreeti can't do so again for 365 days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The efreeti makes three attacks, using Heated Blade or Hurl Flame in any combination.

action.name: Heated Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Fire damage.

action.name: Hurl Flame
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 8}, range 120 ft. {@h}24 ({@damage 7d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elephant makes two Gore attacks.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the elephant moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

bonus.name: Trample
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, one creature within 5 feet that has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. {@actSaveFail} 17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Ram
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the elk moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Bludgeoning damage and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

trait.name: Diabolical Restoration
entries: If the erinyes dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in the Nine Hells.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The erinyes has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Rope
entries: The erinyes has a magic rope. While bearing it, the erinyes can use the Entangling Rope action. The rope has AC 20, HP 90, and {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Poison and Psychic damage. The rope turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, if it is 5+ feet away from the erinyes for 1 hour or more, or if the erinyes dies. If the rope is damaged or destroyed, the erinyes can fully restore it when finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The erinyes makes three Withering Sword attacks and can use Entangling Rope.

action.name: Withering Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Entangling Rope (Requires Magic Rope)
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 16}, one creature the erinyes can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Force damage, and the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until the rope is destroyed, the erinyes uses a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to release the target, or the erinyes uses Entangling Rope again.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The erinyes is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The erinyes adds 4 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The ettercap can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The ettercap ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the ettercap knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettercap makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition until the start of the ettercap's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Web Strand {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, one Large or smaller creature the ettercap can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; {@variantrule Vulnerability|SRD52} to Fire damage; {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to Bludgeoning, Poison, and Psychic damage).

bonus.name: Reel
entries: The ettercap pulls one creature within 30 feet of itself that is {@condition Restrained|SRD52} by its Web Strand up to 25 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ettin makes one Battleaxe attack and one Morningstar attack.

action.name: Battleaxe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Morningstar
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage, and the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Fire Aura
entries: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the elemental takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} start {@hazard burning|SRD52}.

trait.name: Fire Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so, and it can enter a creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Fire damage.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The elemental sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 30-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: The elemental takes 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Cold damage for every 5 feet the elemental moves in water or for every gallon of water splashed on it.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two Burn attacks.

action.name: Burn
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it starts {@hazard burning|SRD52}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Flame Sword or Hammer Throw in any combination.

action.name: Flame Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d6 + 7}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Hammer Throw
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 11}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Fire damage, and the target is pushed up to 15 feet straight away from the giant and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

monster.name: Flesh Golem
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Aversion to Fire
entries: If the golem takes Fire damage, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Berserk
entries: Whenever the golem starts its turn {@status Bloodied|SRD52}, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it remains so until it is destroyed or it is no longer {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

The golem's creator, if within 60 feet of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by taking an action to make a {@dc 15} Charisma ({@skill Persuasion|SRD52}) check; the golem must be able to hear its creator. If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem can't shape-shift.

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Lightning damage.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The snake doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The frog can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Standing Leap
entries: The frog's {@variantrule Long Jump|SRD52} is up to 10 feet and its {@variantrule High Jump|SRD52} is up to 5 feet with or without a running start.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Frost Axe or Great Bow in any combination.

action.name: Frost Axe
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 2d12 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Cold damage.

action.name: Great Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: War Cry {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} and has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The gargoyle doesn't provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The gargoyle makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Slashing damage.

trait.name: Ooze Cube
entries: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube's Engulf and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on the saving throw.
Creatures inside the cube have {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover}, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time.

As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check, and the puller takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage.

trait.name: Transparent
entries: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill Perception|SRD52}) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn't witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Acid damage.

action.name: Engulf
entries: The cube moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52|Opportunity Attacks}. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} trait). {@actSave dex} {@dc 12}, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can't cast spells with a Verbal component, has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition, and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube's turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a {@dc 12} Strength ({@skill Athletics|SRD52}) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 13}, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost's game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, as well as the target's Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or the ghost leaves as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule Possession|SRD52} for 24 hours. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this ghost's {@variantrule Possession|SRD52} for 24 hours.
