spellcasting.name: Protective Magic
headerEntries: The lich casts {@spell Counterspell|SRD52} or {@spell Shield|SRD52} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Frightening Gaze
headerEntries: The lich casts {@spell Fear|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day, or 5/Day in Lair)
entries: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Spirit Jar
entries: If destroyed, the lich reforms in {@dice 1d10} days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich's lair.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lich makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

action.name: Eldritch Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}31 ({@damage 4d12 + 5}) Force damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until the start of the lich's next turn.

legendary.name: Deathly Teleport
entries: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each creature that isn't an Undead in a 20-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the lich. {@actSaveFail} 31 ({@damage 9d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The lich can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Pack Tactics
entries: The lion has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

trait.name: Running Leap
entries: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can {@variantrule Long Jump|SRD52} up to 25 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Roar
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, one creature within 15 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the start of the lion's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Misty Step (3/Day)
headerEntries: The mage casts {@spell Misty Step|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

spellcasting.name: Protective Magic (3/Day)
headerEntries: The mage casts {@spell Counterspell|SRD52} or {@spell Shield|SRD52} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.

action.name: Arcane Burst
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Force damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Slashing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The magmin explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 11}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the magmin. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn't being worn or carried, it starts {@hazard burning|SRD52}.

bonus.name: Ignited Illumination
entries: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d10 + 7}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

bonus.name: Trample
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, one creature within 5 feet that has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. {@actSaveFail} 29 ({@damage 4d10 + 7}) Bludgeoning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail Spike
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 100/200 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The marilith has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reactive
entries: The marilith can take one {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} on every turn of combat.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.

action.name: Pact Blade
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Constrict
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 17}, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 14}), and it has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition until the grapple ends.

bonus.name: Teleport {@recharge 5}
entries: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Snake Hair
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Poison Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 150 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Petrifying Gaze {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. If the medusa sees its reflection in the {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}, the medusa must make this save. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still {@condition Restrained|SRD52}, ending the effect on itself on a success. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Petrified|SRD52} condition instead of the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merfolk can breathe air and water.

action.name: Ocean Spear
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d6}) Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. {@hom}The spear magically returns to the merfolk's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The merrow can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition until the end of the merrow's next turn.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Harpoon
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.

trait.name: Adhesive (Object Form Only)
entries: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} (with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} if the target is {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the mimic), reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage—or 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage if the target is {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the mimic—plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

action.name: Abyssal Glaive
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Gore {@recharge 5}
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Piercing damage and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Beast of Burden
entries: The mule counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum doesn't return to normal when finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this attack.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this mummy's Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}, {@hit 9} to hit with spell attacks):

spellcasting.name: Dread Command
headerEntries: The mummy casts {@spell Command|SRD52} (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The mummy has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Undead Restoration
entries: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy's lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and {@variantrule Immunity|SRD52} to all damage except Fire.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.

action.name: Rotting Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it gains no benefit from finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, and its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 10 ({@dice 3d6}) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} by this attack.

action.name: Channel Negative Energy
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 60 ft. {@h}25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Dreadful Glare
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 17}, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 25 ({@damage 6d6 + 4}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

reaction.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries: {@actTrigger} The mummy is hit by an attack roll. {@actResponse} The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition until the end of the mummy's next turn.

legendary.name: Glare
entries: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Necrotic Strike
entries: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.

trait.name: Demonic Restoration
entries: If the nalfeshnee dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in the Abyss.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The nalfeshnee has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The nalfeshnee makes three Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Force damage.

action.name: Teleport
entries: The nalfeshnee teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus.name: Horror Nimbus {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 15}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the nalfeshnee. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or until it ends its turn with the nalfeshnee out of line of sight. {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to this nalfeshnee's Horror Nimbus for 24 hours.

reaction.name: Pursuit
entries: {@actTrigger} Another creature the nalfeshnee can see ends its move within 120 feet of the nalfeshnee. {@actResponse} The nalfeshnee uses Teleport, but its destination space must be within 10 feet of the triggering creature.

spellcasting.name: Coven Magic
headerEntries: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell's normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}): {@spell Augury|SRD52}, {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52}, {@spell Identify|SRD52}, {@spell Locate Object|SRD52}, {@spell Scrying|SRD52}, or {@spell Unseen Servant|SRD52}. The hag must finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52} before using this trait to cast that spell again.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

spellcasting.name: Nightmare Haunting (1/Day; Requires Soul Bag)
headerEntries: While on the Ethereal Plane, the hag casts {@spell Dream|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Only the hag can serve as the spell's messenger, and the target must be a creature the hag can see on the Material Plane. The spell fails and is wasted if the target is under the effect of the {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|SRD52} spell or within a {@spell Magic Circle|SRD52} spell.

If the target takes damage from the {@spell Dream|SRD52} spell, the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to that damage. If the spell kills the target, its soul is trapped in the hag's soul bag, and the target can't be raised from the dead until its soul is released.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The hag has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Soul Bag
entries: The hag has a soul bag. While holding or carrying the bag, the hag can use its Nightmare Haunting action.

The bag has AC 15, HP 20, and {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to all damage. The bag turns to dust if reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. If the bag is destroyed, any souls the bag is holding are released. The hag can create a new bag after 7 days.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The hag makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The hag shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Confer Fire Resistance
entries: The nightmare can grant {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Fire damage to a rider while it is on the nightmare.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The nightmare sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} for an additional 10 feet.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Fire damage.

action.name: Ethereal Stride
entries: The nightmare and up to three willing creatures within 5 feet of it teleport to the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane or vice versa.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d8 + 1}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Parry
entries: {@actTrigger} The noble is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} The noble adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

trait.name: Amorphous
entries: The jelly can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The jelly can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

action.name: Pseudopod
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 3d6 + 2}) Acid damage.

reaction.name: Split
entries: {@actTrigger} While the jelly is Large or Medium and has 10+ {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it becomes {@status Bloodied|SRD52} or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. {@actResponse} The jelly splits into two new Ochre Jellies. Each new jelly is one size smaller than the original jelly and acts on its {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52}. The original jelly's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} are divided evenly between the new jellies (round down).

trait.name: Compression
entries: The octopus can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The octopus can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Bludgeoning damage.

reaction.name: Ink Cloud (1/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature ends its turn within 5 feet of the octopus while underwater. {@actResponse} The octopus releases ink that fills a 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its {@variantrule Swim Speed|SRD52}. The {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cube} is {@variantrule Heavily Obscured|SRD52} for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.

action.name: Greatclub
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Piercing damage.

monster.name: Ogre Zombie
languages: understands Common and Giant but can't speak

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|SRD52}. On a successful save, the zombie drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} instead.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The oni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}):

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
headerEntries: The oni casts {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} on itself, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The oni regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The oni makes two Claw or Nightmare Ray attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 1d12 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Nightmare Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d6 + 2}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition until the start of the oni's next turn.

action.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The oni shape-shifts into a Small or Medium Humanoid or a Large Giant, or it returns to its true form. Other than its size, its game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

monster.name: Otyugh
languages: Otyugh; telepathy 120 ft. (doesn't allow the receiving creature to respond telepathically)

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The otyugh makes one Bite attack and two Tentacle attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition. Whenever the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} target finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by 5 ({@dice 1d10}) and doesn't return to normal until the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition ends on the target. {@actSaveSuccess} The {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition ends.

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 13}) from one of two tentacles.

action.name: Tentacle Slam
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 14}, each creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the otyugh. {@actSaveFail} 16 ({@damage 3d8 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition Stunned|SRD52} condition until the start of the otyugh's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: Flyby
entries: The owl doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|SRD52|Opportunity Attacks} when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: Talons
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Slashing damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The owlbear makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

bonus.name: Nimble Escape
entries: The panther takes the {@action Disengage|SRD52} or {@action Hide|SRD52} action.

action.name: Hooves

trait.name: Lightning Absorption
entries: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.

action.name: Charged Tendril
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.

action.name: Engulf
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into the shambling mound's space and has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 14}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions, and it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by this action at a time.

monster.name: Shield Guardian
languages: understands commands given in any language but can't speak

trait.name: Bound
entries: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The guardian regains 10 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}.

trait.name: Spell Storing
entries: A spellcaster who wears the guardian's amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster's spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.

action.name: Fist
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Force damage.

reaction.name: Protection
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian's amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. {@actResponse} The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian's next turn.

reaction.name: Shriek
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature or a source of {@variantrule Bright Light|SRD52} moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. {@actResponse} The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Cold Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Cold damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Paralyzing Breath
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail 1} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

monster.name: Skeleton
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Shortbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 80/320 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 25}):

spellcasting.name: Divine Aid (3/Day)
headerEntries: The solar casts {@spell Cure Wounds|SRD52} (level 2 version), {@spell Lesser Restoration|SRD52}, or {@spell Remove Curse|SRD52}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: Divine Awareness
entries: The solar knows if it hears a lie.

trait.name: Exalted Restoration
entries: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} somewhere in Mount Celestia.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The solar has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.

action.name: Flying Sword
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 15}, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d6 + 8}) Slashing damage plus 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Radiant damage. {@hom}The sword magically returns to the solar's hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.

action.name: Slaying Bow
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 21}, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. {@actSaveFail} If the creature has 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 ({@damage 4d8 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Radiant damage.

legendary.name: Blinding Gaze
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 25}, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} condition for 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The solar can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: Radiant Teleport
entries: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. {@actSave dex} {@dc 25}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the solar at its destination space. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Radiant damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

monster.name: Specter
languages: understands Common plus one other language but can't speak

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|SRD52}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the specter has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ability checks and attack rolls.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|SRD52}) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 3d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Mind-Rending Roar {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, each enemy in a 300-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the sphinx. {@actSaveFail} 35 ({@damage 10d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition until the start of the sphinx's next turn.

legendary.name: Arcane Prowl
entries: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Weight of Years
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level. While the target has any {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} levels, it appears {@dice 3d10} years older. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

trait.name: Inscrutable
entries: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom ({@skill Insight|SRD52}) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52}.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d6 + 6}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Roar (3/Day)
entries: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}):

items.name: First Roar
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, each enemy in a 500-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the sphinx. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|SRD52} condition for 1 minute.

items.name: Second Roar
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 20}, each enemy in a 500-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the sphinx. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.

items.name: Third Roar
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 20}, each enemy in a 500-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the sphinx. {@actSaveFail} 44 ({@damage 8d10}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: Arcane Prowl
entries: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.

legendary.name: Weight of Years
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 16}, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} The target gains 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level. While the target has any {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} levels, it appears {@dice 3d10} years older. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The sphinx can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The sphinx has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Radiant damage.

reaction.name: Burst of Ingenuity (2/Day)
entries: {@actTrigger} The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. {@actResponse} The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Web Walker
entries: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Poison damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: Fiendish Restoration
entries: If it dies, the naga returns to life in {@dice 1d6} days and regains all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}. Only a {@spell Wish|SRD52} spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 10 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Necrotic Ray
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 60 ft. {@h}21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage.

spellcasting.name: Invisibility
headerEntries: The sprite casts {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

action.name: Needle Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Enchanting Bow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 6}, range 40/160 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition until the start of the sprite's next turn.

action.name: Heart Sight
entries: {@actSave cha} {@dc 10}, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). {@actSaveFail} The sprite knows the target's emotions and alignment.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

action.name: Hand Crossbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage.

bonus.name: Cunning Action
entries: The spy takes the {@action Dash|SRD52}, {@action Disengage|SRD52}, or {@action Hide|SRD52} action.

trait.name: Blurred Form
entries: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} unless the mephit has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition.

trait.name: Death Burst
entries: The mephit explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from the mephit. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}2 ({@damage 1d4}) Slashing damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Fire damage.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 10}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Fire damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Being underwater doesn't grant {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to this Fire damage.

action.name: Proboscis
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can't make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge's turns.
The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.

action.name: Stone Club
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 15 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Boulder
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 60/240 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

reaction.name: Deflect Missile {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actTrigger} The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. {@actResponse} The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 ({@dice 1d10 + 6}), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack's force. {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Force damage.

monster.name: Stone Golem
languages: understands Common plus two other languages but can't speak

spellcasting.name: Slow {@recharge 5}
headerEntries: The golem casts the {@spell Slow|SRD52} spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}).

trait.name: Immutable Form
entries: The golem can't shape-shift.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The golem has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Force damage.

action.name: Force Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 120 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 4d10}) Force damage.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 18}):

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The giant can breathe air and water.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.

action.name: Storm Sword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 14}, reach 10 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 4d6 + 9}) Slashing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Lightning damage.

action.name: Thunderbolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 14}, range 500 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 2d12 + 9}) Lightning damage, and the target has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Deafened|SRD52} conditions until the start of the giant's next turn.

action.name: Lightning Storm {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cylinder} originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. {@actSaveFail} 55 ({@damage 10d10}) Lightning damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: Incubus Form
entries: When the succubus finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, it can shape-shift into an {@creature Incubus|SRD52}, using that stat block instead of this one.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.

action.name: Fiendish Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d10 + 5}) Psychic damage.

action.name: Charm
entries: The succubus casts {@spell Dominate Person|SRD52} (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}).

action.name: Draining Kiss
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature {@condition Charmed|SRD52} by the succubus within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target's {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.

bonus.name: Shape-Shift
entries: The succubus shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small Humanoid or back into its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} is available only in its true form. Any equipment it's wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Swarm of Grasping Hands
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 4d8 + 2}) Necrotic damage, or 11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Necrotic damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: If the swarm has a {@variantrule Climb Speed|SRD52}, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 2d4 + 1}) Poison damage, or 3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Poison damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny piranha. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The swarm can breathe only underwater.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} (with {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} if the target doesn't have all its {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}), reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage, or 5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 2}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 2d4}) Piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Beaks
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage, or 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}.

action.name: Cacophony {@recharge}
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 10}, one creature in the swarm's space. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Deafened|SRD52} condition until the start of the swarm's next turn. While {@condition Deafened|SRD52}, the target also has {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on ability checks and attack rolls.

trait.name: Swarm
entries: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} or gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}.

action.name: Bites
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage—or 6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage if the swarm is {@status Bloodied|SRD52}—plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Poison damage.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (6/Day)
entries: If the tarrasque fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The tarrasque has {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Reflective Carapace
entries: If the tarrasque is targeted by a {@spell Magic Missile|SRD52} spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 1-5, the tarrasque is unaffected. On a 6, the tarrasque is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

trait.name: Siege Monster
entries: The tarrasque deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The tarrasque makes one Bite attack and three other attacks, using Claw or Tail in any combination.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}36 ({@damage 4d12 + 10}) Piercing damage, and the target has the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition (escape {@dc 20}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and can't teleport.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 15 ft. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d8 + 10}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 19}, reach 30 ft. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d8 + 10}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition.

action.name: Thunderous Bellow {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 27}, each creature and each object that isn't being worn or carried in a 150-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} 78 ({@damage 12d12}) Thunder damage, and the target has the {@condition Deafened|SRD52} and {@condition Frightened|SRD52} conditions until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: Swallow
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 27}, one Large or smaller creature {@condition Grappled|SRD52} by the tarrasque (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). {@actSaveFail} The target is swallowed, and the {@condition Grappled|SRD52} condition ends. A swallowed creature has the {@condition Blinded|SRD52} and {@condition Restrained|SRD52} conditions and can't teleport, it has {@variantrule Cover|SRD52|Total Cover} against attacks and other effects outside the tarrasque, and it takes 56 ({@damage 16d6}) Acid damage at the start of each of the tarrasque's turns.

If the tarrasque takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the tarrasque must succeed on a {@dc 20} Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the tarrasque and has the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition. If the tarrasque dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the {@condition Restrained|SRD52} condition and can escape from the corpse using 20 feet of movement, exiting {@condition Prone|SRD52}.

legendary.name: Onslaught
entries: The tarrasque moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Claw or Tail attack.

legendary.name: World-Shaking Movement
entries: The tarrasque moves up to its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. At the end of this movement, the tarrasque creates an instantaneous shock wave in a 60-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Emanation} originating from itself. The tree takes its turn immediately after the treant on the same {@variantrule Initiative|SRD52} count, and it obeys the treant. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 {@condition Exhaustion|SRD52} level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}.

Once in its resting place, it returns to its vampire form and has the {@condition Paralyzed|SRD52} condition until it regains any {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52}, and it regains 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} after spending 1 hour there.

action.name: Necrotic Bow

action.name: Life Drain

A Humanoid slain by this attack rises 24 hours later as a {@creature Zombie|SRD52} under the wight's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed. The wight can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at a time.

bonus.name: Vanish

optionalfeature.name: Agonizing Blast

spell.entry: a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage

entries: Choose one of your known {@filter Warlock cantrips|spells|level=0|class=Warlock|damage type=acid;bludgeoning;cold;fire;force;lightning;necrotic;piercing;poison;psychic;radiant;slashing;thunder} that deals damage. You can add your Charisma modifier to that spell's damage rolls.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

optionalfeature.name: Armor of Shadows
entries: You can cast {@spell Mage Armor|SRD52} on yourself without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Ascendant Step
entries: You can cast {@spell Levitate|SRD52} on yourself without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Careful Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell's full force. To do so, spend 1 Sorcery Point and choose a number of those creatures up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell, and it takes no damage if it would normally take half damage on a successful save.

optionalfeature.name: Devil's Sight
entries: You can see normally in {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} and {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}—both magical and nonmagical—within 120 feet of yourself.

optionalfeature.name: Devouring Blade
entries: The Extra Attack of your {@optionalfeature Thirsting Blade|SRD52} invocation confers two extra attacks rather than one.

optionalfeature.name: Distant Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 5 feet, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double the spell's range. Or when you cast a spell that has a range of Touch, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to make the spell's range 30 feet.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Mind
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|SRD52}.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Smite
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can expend a Pact Magic spell slot to deal an extra {@damage 1d8} Force damage to the target, plus another {@damage 1d8} per level of the spell slot, and you can give the target the {@condition Prone|SRD52} condition if it is Huge or smaller.

optionalfeature.name: Eldritch Spear

spell.entry: a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage

entries: Choose one of your known {@filter Warlock cantrips|spells|level=0|class=Warlock|damage type=acid;bludgeoning;cold;fire;force;lightning;necrotic;piercing;poison;psychic;radiant;slashing;thunder|range=point} that deals damage and has a range of 10+ feet. When you cast that spell, its range increases by a number of feet equal to 30 times your Warlock level.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

optionalfeature.name: Empowered Spell
entries: When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one), and you must use the new rolls.
You can use Empowered Spell even if you've already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Extended Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to double its duration to a maximum duration of 24 hours.
If the affected spell requires {@status Concentration|SRD52}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on any saving throw you make to maintain that {@status Concentration|SRD52}.

optionalfeature.name: Fiendish Vigor
entries: You can cast {@spell False Life|SRD52} on yourself without expending a spell slot. When you cast the spell with this feature, you don't roll the die for the {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52}; you automatically get the highest number on the die.

optionalfeature.name: Gaze of Two Minds
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to touch a willing creature and perceive through its senses until the end of your next turn. As long as the creature is on the same plane of existence as you, you can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} on subsequent turns to maintain this connection, extending the duration until the end of your next turn. The connection ends if you don't maintain it in this way.

While perceiving through the other creature's senses, you benefit from any special senses possessed by that creature, and you can cast spells as if you were in your space or the other creature's space if the two of you are within 60 feet of each other.

optionalfeature.name: Gift of the Depths
entries: You can breathe underwater, and you gain a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.
You can also cast {@spell Water Breathing|SRD52} once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way again when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

optionalfeature.name: Gift of the Protectors
entries: A new page appears in your Book of Shadows when you conjure it. With your permission, a creature can take an action to write its name on that page, which can contain a number of names equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one name).

When any creature whose name is on the page is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} but not killed outright, the creature magically drops to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} instead. Once this magic is triggered, no creature can benefit from it until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.
As a {@action Magic|SRD52} action, you can erase a name on the page by touching it.

optionalfeature.name: Heightened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that forces a creature to make a saving throw, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to give one target of the spell {@variantrule Disadvantage|SRD52} on saves against the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Investment of the Chain Master
entries: When you cast {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52}, you infuse the summoned familiar with a measure of your eldritch power, granting the creature the following benefits.

entries.name: Aerial or Aquatic
entries: The familiar gains either a Fly Speed or a Swim Speed (your choice) of 40 feet.

entries.name: Quick Attack
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can command the familiar to take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action.

entries.name: Necrotic or Radiant Damage
entries: Whenever the familiar deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can make it deal Necrotic or Radiant damage instead.

entries.name: Your Save DC
entries: If the familiar forces a creature to make a saving throw, it uses your spell save DC.

entries.name: Resistance
entries: When the familiar takes damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52} to grant it {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} against that damage.

optionalfeature.name: Lessons of the First Ones
entries: You have received knowledge from an elder entity of the multiverse, allowing you to gain one Origin feat of your choice (see "Feats").

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different Origin feat.

optionalfeature.name: Lifedrinker
entries: Once per turn when you hit a creature with your pact weapon, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d6} Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage (your choice) to the creature, and you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|SRD52} to roll it and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52} equal to the roll plus your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point}).

optionalfeature.name: Mask of Many Faces
entries: You can cast {@spell Disguise Self|SRD52} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Master of Myriad Forms
entries: You can cast {@spell Alter Self|SRD52} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Misty Visions
entries: You can cast {@spell Silent Image|SRD52} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: One with Shadows
entries: While you're in an area of {@variantrule Dim Light|SRD52} or {@variantrule Darkness|SRD52}, you can cast {@spell Invisibility|SRD52} on yourself without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Otherworldly Leap
entries: You can cast {@spell Jump|SRD52} on yourself without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Blade
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you can conjure a pact weapon in your hand—a Simple or Martial Melee weapon of your choice with which you bond—or create a bond with a magic weapon you touch; you can't bond with a magic weapon if someone else is attuned to it or another Warlock is bonded with it. Until the bond ends, you have proficiency with the weapon, and you can use it as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|SRD52}.

Whenever you attack with the bonded weapon, you can use your Charisma modifier for the attack and damage rolls instead of using Strength or Dexterity; and you can cause the weapon to deal Necrotic, Psychic, or Radiant damage or its normal damage type.

Your bond with the weapon ends if you use this feature's {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} again, if the weapon is more than 5 feet away from you for 1 minute or more, or if you die. A conjured weapon disappears when the bond ends.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Chain
entries: You learn the {@spell Find Familiar|SRD52} spell and can cast it as a {@action Magic|SRD52} action without expending a spell slot.

When you cast the spell, you choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: {@creature Imp|SRD52}, {@creature Pseudodragon|SRD52}, {@creature Quasit|SRD52}, {@creature Skeleton|SRD52}, {@creature Slaad Tadpole|SRD52}, {@creature Sphinx of Wonder|SRD52}, {@creature Sprite|SRD52}, or {@creature Venomous Snake|SRD52} (see appendix B for the familiar's stat block).
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your familiar to make one attack of its own with its {@variantrule Reaction|SRD52}.

optionalfeature.name: Pact of the Tome
entries: Stitching together strands of shadow, you conjure forth a book in your hand at the end of a {@variantrule Short Rest|SRD52|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. This Book of Shadows (you determine its appearance) contains eldritch magic that only you can access, granting you the benefits below. The book disappears if you conjure another book with this feature or if you die.

entries.name: Cantrips and Rituals
entries: When the book appears, choose three {@filter cantrips|spells|level=0}, and choose two {@filter level 1 spells|spells|level=1|components & miscellaneous=ritual} that have the {@variantrule Ritual|SRD52} tag. The spells can be from any class's spell list, and they must be spells you don't already have prepared. While the book is on your person, you have the chosen spells prepared, and they function as Warlock spells for you.

entries.name: Spellcasting Focus
entries: You can use the book as a {@variantrule Spellcasting Focus|SRD52}.

optionalfeature.name: Quickened Spell
entries: When you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can spend 2 Sorcery Points to change the casting time to a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} for this casting. You can't modify a spell in this way if you've already cast a level 1+ spell on the current turn, nor can you cast a level 1+ spell on this turn after modifying a spell in this way.

optionalfeature.name: Repelling Blast

spell.entry: a Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage via an Attack Roll
spell.entrySummary: Warlock Cantrip That Deals Damage via an Attack Roll

entries: Choose one of your known {@filter Warlock cantrips|spells|level=0|class=Warlock|spell attack=m;r;o} that requires an attack roll. When you hit a Large or smaller creature with that cantrip, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can gain this invocation more than once. Each time you do so, choose a different eligible cantrip.

optionalfeature.name: Subtle Spell
entries: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to cast it without any Verbal, Somatic, or Material components, except Material components that are consumed by the spell or that have a cost specified in the spell.

optionalfeature.name: Thirsting Blade
entries: You gain the Extra Attack feature for your pact weapon only. With that feature, you can attack twice with the weapon instead of once when you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action on your turn.

optionalfeature.name: Twinned Spell
entries: When you cast a spell, such as {@spell Charm Person|SRD52}, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot to target an additional creature, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to increase the spell's effective level by 1.

optionalfeature.name: Visions of Distant Realms
entries: You can cast {@spell Arcane Eye|SRD52} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Whispers of the Grave
entries: You can cast {@spell Speak with Dead|SRD52} without expending a spell slot.

optionalfeature.name: Witch Sight
entries: You have {@sense Truesight|SRD52} with a range of 30 feet.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 5-7 feet tall)

entries.name: Draconic Ancestry
entries: Your lineage stems from a dragon progenitor. Choose the kind of dragon from the Draconic Ancestors table. Your choice affects your Breath Weapon and {@variantrule Damage|SRD52} {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} traits as well as your appearance.

entries.name: Breath Weapon
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|SRD52} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with an exhalation of magical energy in either a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone} or a 30-foot {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line} that is 5 feet wide (choose the shape each time). Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} damage of the type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when you reach character levels 5 ({@damage 2d10}), 11 ({@damage 3d10}), and 17 ({@damage 4d10}).
You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Draconic Flight
entries: When you reach character level 5, you can channel draconic magic to give yourself temporary flight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you sprout spectral wings on your back that last for 10 minutes or until you retract the wings (no action required) or have the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition. During that time, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|SRD52} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}. Your wings appear to be made of the same energy as your Breath Weapon. Once you use this trait, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

items.name: Breath Weapon

Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Constitution modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 1d10} {{damageType}} damage. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage. This damage increases by {@damage 1d10} when you reach character levels 5 ({@damage 2d10}), 11 ({@damage 3d10}), and 17 ({@damage 4d10}).
You can use this Breath Weapon a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

items.name: Damage Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to {{damageType}} damage.

entries.name: Dwarven Resilience
entries: You have {@variantrule Resistance|SRD52} to Poison damage. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|SRD52} condition.

entries.name: Dwarven Toughness
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|SRD52|Hit Point} maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

entries.name: Stonecunning
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, you gain {@sense Tremorsense|SRD52} with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You must be on a stone surface or touching a stone surface to use this {@sense Tremorsense|SRD52}. The stone can be natural or worked.

You can use this {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}.

entries.name: Elven Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

entries.caption: Elven Lineages
rows: The range of your {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Dancing Lights|SRD52} cantrip.

You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|SRD52} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.
Your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} increases to 35 feet. You also know the {@spell Druidcraft|SRD52} cantrip.

entries.name: Fey Ancestry
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|SRD52} condition.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|SRD52}, {@skill Perception|SRD52}, or {@skill Survival|SRD52} skill.

entries.name: Trance
entries: You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52} in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a trancelike meditation, during which you retain consciousness.

items.name: Elven Lineage (Drow)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. The range of your {@sense Darkvision|SRD52} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Dancing Lights|SRD52} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Faerie Fire|SRD52} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Darkness|SRD52} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

items.name: Darkvision

items.name: Elven Lineage (High Elf)

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Detect Magic|SRD52} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Misty Step|SRD52} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

items.name: Elven Lineage (Wood Elf)
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Your {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} increases to 35 feet. You also know the {@spell Druidcraft|SRD52} cantrip.

When you reach character level 3, you learn the {@spell Longstrider|SRD52} spell. When you reach character level 5, you also learn the {@spell Pass without Trace|SRD52} spell. You always have these spells prepared, and you can cast each spell once without a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|SRD52} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Gnomish Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage):

items.name: Forest Gnome
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|SRD52} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|SRD52} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.

items.name: Rock Gnome
entries: You know the {@spell Mending|SRD52} and {@spell Prestidigitation|SRD52} cantrips. In addition, you can spend 10 minutes casting {@spell Prestidigitation|SRD52} to create a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 HP), such as a toy, fire starter, or music box. When you create the device, you determine its function by choosing one effect from {@spell Prestidigitation|SRD52}; the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52} to activate it with a touch. If the chosen effect has options within it, you choose one of those options for the device when you create it. For example, if you choose the spell's ignite-extinguish effect, you determine whether the device ignites or extinguishes fire; the device doesn't do both. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a {@action Utilize|SRD52} action.

items.name: Gnomish Lineage (Forest Gnome)
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|SRD52} cantrip. You also always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|SRD52} spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|SRD52|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|SRD52}. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell.
